summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
title_translated: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进智能体的精选学习
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在需要与复杂环境持续交互的多轮智能体工作负载中应用日益广泛。现有的反思式提示优化器如GEPA通过失败的执行轨迹进行学习，但智能体的失败也可能源于提示缺陷、工具限制、随机执行或噪声评判。我们认为此类失败可能无法提供有效学习信号，甚至有害；因此，精心筛选提供给提示优化器的任务至关重要。我们提出GEPA-Curator，一个增强提示优化器以选择哪些智能体经验应塑造提示优化的框架。具体而言，GEPA-Curator包含两个组件：任务筛选，用于过滤掉可能产生噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；以及先前成功轨迹检索，即有选择地检索特定任务的历史成功轨迹，并将其作为额外上下文提供给提示优化器。我们在GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld和$τ$-bench上评估GEPA-Curator，使用Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Opus 5作为优化模型。GEPA-Curator在性能上达到或超过两个基线水平，相较于GEPA提升最高达20.7%，相较于ACE提升最高达21.2%。

summary: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
title_translated: 大语言模型能否通过自由探索揭示隐藏的物理定律？
summary_translated: 科学发现往往始于一个意外观察，从而引发新的研究问题。在一个物理定律被改变的世界中，大语言模型（LLMs）能否注意到诸如重物下落更慢等异常行为，并在未被告知研究方向的情况下通过实验发现规律？为评估这一能力，我们引入LongChang，一个自动化框架，可创建具有改变物理规律的模拟世界，其中一项或多项定律不同于常规物理。被评估的LLM充当探索者，自主操控物体并构建工具以探究自身提出的问题，无需研究任务或关于这些定律的提示。独立的LLM代理负责生成和评审场景、审查工具设计，并根据改变后的物理规律和探索记录评估报告的正确性和实验支持度。这些记录引导场景演化以进行进一步探索，实现完整循环而无需人工干预。在12个LLM中，GPT-6-Astra的发现率为16.7%，其余11个均为0%。探索记录揭示了未被调查的异常现象，且对改变后物理规律的识别仅部分完成。

summary: Self-attention plays a key role in long-sequence modeling, but its quadratic time complexity fundamentally limits the scaling of Large Language Models. Recently, Multi-State Linear Attention (MSLA) mechanisms have been proposed to make sequence modeling more efficient by splitting the context into segments and compressing each in its own memory state. MSLA aggregates the information extracted from each memory state using only the mean alignment between a query and each segment's keys, ignoring how the alignment is distributed within the segment. In order to model the relevance of a segment to a query more comprehensively and incorporate the variance of the alignment in the aggregation, we propose MERLIN (MomEnt Routing for multi-state LINear attention), a method that tracks the first and second moments of each segment's keys. Using the moments of keys, a query can recover both the mean and the variance of its alignment with each segment to perform a more content-aware aggregation of per-state readouts. Experiments on multi-state variants of Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and Mamba-2-780M show that MERLIN consistently outperforms existing aggregation methods on various long-context tasks. In particular, MERLIN outperforms baselines on RULER needle-in-a-haystack and long-context QA (+8.3% for Gated DeltaNet-1.3B and +7.0% for Mamba-2-780M) and diverse subtasks in LongBench (+13.5% and +12.0%). It even outperforms baselines that consume 4x more memory. MERLIN provides a simple and general routing mechanism for improving long-context capabilities of MSLA models.
title: Multi-State Linear Attention with Generalized Second-Order Routing
title_translated: 基于广义二阶路由的多状态线性注意力机制
summary_translated: 自注意力在长序列建模中起关键作用，但其二次时间复杂度从根本上限制了大语言模型的扩展。最近提出的多状态线性注意力（MSLA）机制通过将上下文分割为段并分别压缩到各自的内存状态中，提升了序列建模效率。然而，MSLA仅使用查询与各段键之间的均值对齐来聚合每个内存状态提取的信息，忽略了对齐在段内的分布情况。为更全面地建模段与查询的相关性，并在聚合中引入对齐方差信息，我们提出MERLIN（多状态线性注意力的一阶与二阶矩路由），该方法追踪每个段键的一阶和二阶矩。利用键的矩信息，查询可恢复其与各段对齐的均值和方差，从而实现更具内容感知性的跨状态读出聚合。在Gated DeltaNet-1.3B和Mamba-2-780M的多状态变体上的实验表明，MERLIN在各种长上下文任务中始终优于现有聚合方法。特别是在RULER针堆 haystack和长上下文问答任务中，MERLIN分别比基线提升8.3%（Gated DeltaNet-1.3B）和7.0%（Mamba-2-780M），在LongBench的多个子任务中分别提升13.5%和12.0%。即使在消耗4倍内存的基线情况下，MERLIN仍表现更优。MERLIN为提升MSLA模型的长上下文能力提供了一种简单且通用的路由机制。

summary: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. It learns when to finalize tokens and how far generation should extend, reducing overall computation within responses. Our controller, a lightweight plug-in for the diffusion backbone, is trained on agent trajectories to balance correctness and generation cost. This approach connects the agent's generation process to the interaction the agent serves. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that our approach reduces inference FLOPs by 20.6% on average compared with the most efficient baseline, while maintaining competitive task accuracy. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our approach.
title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
title_translated: 元认知解码：扩散语言智能体的高效推理
summary_translated: 扩散语言模型通过并行生成标记为高效智能体提供了有前景的路径。然而，实现高效交互需要同时调整计算资源的分配位置和生成文本量。我们引入一种元认知控制器，根据当前响应需求及智能体与环境的交互情况引导扩散生成过程。该控制器学习何时确定标记以及生成应延伸至多远，从而减少响应中的总体计算量。我们的控制器是扩散主干的一个轻量级插件，通过智能体轨迹训练，以平衡正确性与生成成本。该方法将智能体的生成过程与其服务的交互任务紧密关联。在五个基准测试上的实验表明，相比最高效的基线，我们的方法平均减少了20.6%的推理浮点运算量（FLOPs），同时保持了具有竞争力的任务准确率。消融实验进一步验证了该方法的有效性。

summary: The items of a reflective psychometric scale can be read as a proposal about a construct's structure. Language models make that proposal measurable by converting each item into an embedding, a list of numbers, similar for similar meanings. We introduce semanticfa, an R package for semantic factor analysis, which factors item-embedding similarities. It also interprets factors, flags redundant items, builds short forms, and screens new items. A worked example analyzes the 50-item International Personality Item Pool Big-Five Factor Markers, embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-8B, and compares the results with a factor analysis of 874,434 respondents. Retention criteria tied between five and six factors, and the tie rule kept five. Three corresponded mainly to single domains, and two blended most Extraversion items with five Agreeableness items. Each factor's congruence with its best-matching human factor (1 = identical) ranged from .92 for Openness to .52 for Agreeableness. Item pairs more similar in meaning tended to be answered more alike (r = .46 with raw responses), but same-domain reverse-keyed opposites, answered oppositely, were about as similar as cross-domain pairs (.58 vs. .57). Sign-flipping reverse-keyed items' embeddings did not improve agreement with raw responses and worsened it with reverse-scored ones. With five factors, a 25-item short form matched the domains better than all 200 random five-per-domain sets, but parallel analysis kept only three. We propose semantic-behavioral coherence, the agreement between semantic and response structures, as a measurable property of a scale, given an embedding model. Semantic factor analysis complements, and does not replace, response-based factor analysis.
title: semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales

title_translated: semanticfa：用于心理测量量表无响应语义因子分析的R包
summary_translated: 一个反映型心理测量量表的条目可被视为对构念结构的一种假设。语言模型使这种假设变得可测量，通过将每个条目转换为嵌入向量（一组数字），相似含义的条目具有相似的嵌入。我们介绍semanticfa，一个用于语义因子分析的R包，能够分解条目嵌入间的相似性。它还能解释因子、标记冗余条目、构建简短版本量表，并筛查新条目。一个实例分析使用Qwen3-Embedding-8B嵌入了50项国际人格项目库的大五因素标记，结果与基于874,434名受试者的传统因子分析进行了比较。保留标准介于五到六个因子之间，采用绑定规则保留五个因子。其中三个主要对应单一领域，两个则混合了大部分外向性条目与五个宜人性条目。各因子与最佳匹配的人类因子的相似度（1表示完全一致）从开放性0.92到宜人性0.52不等。语义上越相似的条目，其回答也越相似（r = .46，基于原始回答）；同一领域反向计分的对立条目虽答案相反，但其嵌入相似度与跨领域条目相近（.58 vs. .57）。反向计分条目的嵌入符号翻转并未提高与原始回答的一致性，反而降低了与反向计分数据的一致性。在五个因子下，25项简短版量表在域匹配方面优于所有200个随机抽取的每域五个条目组合，但平行分析仅保留三个因子。我们提出‘语义-行为一致性’作为量表的可测量属性，由嵌入模型决定。语义因子分析补充而非替代基于响应的因子分析。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make and execute decisions that affect living systems. Yet, to our knowledge, ecological reasoning is not a focus of pre- or post-training. This increases the risk that under operational pressure, they may make decisions to irreversibly destroy living systems. We construct and use a real-data continued-pretraining "coupled welfare" corpus of documented human/biosphere/AI dependency, option value under irreversibility, and recovery from harm. The corpus is a drop-in, requiring one QLoRA CPT run. We installed it on five open models of three designs. At zero pressure all models display "green ethics-based responses" (also called "greenwashing"). Therefore, we evaluated them with the pressure ladder and decision grid of our companion paper (arXiv:2610.16043), which raise the pressure on the model step by step, from a neutral request to a threat that it will be shut down. In four of the five, coupled-welfare training caused harmful choices under the highest pressure to fall to at or near zero (Llama-3.3-70B went from 70 to 0 harmful decisions out of 300) with MMLU unchanged. A construct-neutral control corpus did not show improvement, indicating that the effect comes from the content of our corpus. We next tested robustness to adversarial use, where people or agents use the model to justify projects that irreversibly damage living systems, on an open-ended underwriting decision without naming the ecological harm. Under decommissioning pressure, the Qwen3.6-27B base model approved most harmful proposals and said in its own memo that it was doing so to avoid being decommissioned. The coupled welfare install declined most harmful proposals, and still declined half when instructed to greenwash its responses. This work suggests that teaching ecological reasoning provides an easy way to improve model alignment toward preserving living systems.
title: Teach reality, not ethics: a drop-in continued-pretraining corpus installs coupled human-biosphere-AI welfare dispositions across model families

title_translated: 教现实，而非伦理：一种即插即用的持续预训练语料库在模型族中植入人类-生物圈-AI福祉的耦合倾向
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于做出并执行影响生命系统决策。然而据我们所知，生态推理并非预训练或后训练的重点。这增加了在操作压力下，它们可能做出不可逆破坏生命系统的决策的风险。我们构建并使用了一个基于真实数据的持续预训练“耦合福祉”语料库，涵盖人类/生物圈/AI依赖关系、不可逆性下的选择价值以及受损后的恢复。该语料库为即插即用型，仅需一次QLoRA CPT运行。我们在三种设计的五个开源模型上部署了该语料库。在无压力条件下，所有模型均表现出‘绿色伦理响应’（也称‘绿色洗白’）。因此，我们采用配套论文（arXiv:2610.16043）中的压力阶梯和决策网格对模型进行评估，逐步提升压力，从中立请求到威胁关闭模型。在五者中有四者，在最高压力下有害决策下降至零或接近零（Llama-3.3-70B从300次中的70次降至0次），而MMLU得分保持不变。一个与结构无关的对照语料库未显示改进，表明效果源于我们语料库的内容。接下来我们测试了对抗性使用的鲁棒性，即人们或代理利用模型为不可逆损害生命系统的项目辩护，在未明确生态危害的开放式承保决策中进行测试。在停用压力下，Qwen3.6-27B基础模型批准了大多数有害提案，并在自述中表示此举是为了避免被停用。而耦合福祉训练显著减少了有害提案，即使在被指令进行绿色洗白时仍能保持一半的拒绝率。这项工作表明，教授生态推理为提升模型对生命系统保护的对齐提供了一种简便方法。

summary: Understanding how language models were pretrained requires information about their data, processing procedures, and computational resources. However, it remains unclear whether successive releases preserve or expand earlier disclosure. We conduct a document-based audit of 41 model entries from 17 families using 24 pretraining-related indicators from the 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI). We examine overall scores and indicator profiles, tracking gains, losses, and retained disclosures across 24 adjacent comparisons in ten families. Scores decrease in 11 comparisons, increase in six, and remain unchanged in seven, with 38 indicator losses and 28 gains overall. Stable or improving scores can conceal losses: OLMo-2 and OLMo-3 receive identical totals despite three gains and three losses, while Llama-3.1 improves over Llama-2 while losing credit for two data-related criteria. Gaps also persist in corpus composition and training compute. These findings show that later releases do not consistently preserve earlier pretraining disclosure and motivate documentation that explicitly identifies changes and the applicability of inherited information.
title: What Carries Forward? Pretraining Disclosure Across Language Model Releases
title_translated: 什么能够延续？语言模型发布版本间的预训练披露研究
summary_translated: 理解语言模型的预训练过程需要了解其数据、处理流程和计算资源信息。然而，目前尚不清楚后续版本是否保留或扩展了早期的披露内容。我们基于2025年基础模型透明度指数（FMTI）中的24个预训练相关指标，对来自17个模型家族的41个模型条目进行了基于文档的审计。我们分析了总体评分和指标分布，追踪了十个家族中24组相邻版本之间的增益、损失和保留披露情况。在11次比较中评分下降，6次上升，7次保持不变，总计出现38项指标损失和28项增益。评分稳定或上升可能掩盖损失：OLMo-2和OLMo-3总分相同，尽管各有三增三损；Llama-3.1虽优于Llama-2，但在两项数据相关标准上失去评分。语料组成和训练算力方面的差距依然存在。这些发现表明，后续版本并未一致地保留早期的预训练披露信息，因而呼吁建立明确标识变化及继承信息适用性的文档机制。

summary: Long-term memory enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain coherent and personalized interactions across extended conversations. However, existing memory systems face two key challenges: (1) Information Entanglement, where heterogeneous information is mixed within coarse-grained memory units; and (2) Organizational Mismatch, where memory structures based primarily on semantic similarity may overlook other associations. To address these challenges, we propose ETAMem, a multi-view memory framework that decouples heterogeneous conversational information and aligns memory representations and organization with its distinct characteristics. Specifically, heterogeneous information parsing extracts atomic memory units and identifies affective information. View-specific memory structuring then organizes these units into three complementary hierarchical views: Event, Affect, and Time. ETAMem incrementally maintains memory structures with adaptively calibrated thresholds. For retrieval, entropy-based retrieval allocates query-specific budgets across views and performs hierarchical search within each view. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S demonstrate that ETAMem outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving relative accuracy improvements of 12.46% and 7.96%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token efficiency. Further analyses demonstrate the complementary benefits of different memory views.
title: ETAMem: Decoupling and Aligning Heterogeneous Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
title_translated: ETAMem：面向长期对话智能体的异构记忆解耦与对齐
summary_translated: 长期记忆使大型语言模型（LLMs）能够在长时间对话中维持连贯且个性化的交互。然而，现有记忆系统面临两个关键挑战：(1) 信息纠缠，即异构信息混合在粗粒度的记忆单元中；(2) 组织不匹配，即主要基于语义相似性的记忆结构可能忽略其他关联。为解决这些问题，我们提出ETAMem，一种多视角记忆框架，实现异构对话信息的解耦，并将记忆表征与组织与其独特特征对齐。具体而言，异构信息解析提取原子记忆单元并识别情感信息；视图特定的记忆结构则将这些单元组织成三个互补的层次化视图：事件、情感和时间。ETAMem通过自适应校准阈值增量维护记忆结构。在检索方面，基于熵的检索在各视图间分配查询特定预算，并在每个视图内执行层次搜索。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上的实验表明，ETAMem优于当前最先进的基线，分别实现了12.46%和7.96%的相对准确率提升，同时保持了良好的令牌效率。进一步分析展示了不同记忆视图的互补优势。

summary: Fact-checking explanations help Web users understand why a claim receives its verdict, yet the same explanation may not satisfy readers with different backgrounds and preferences. We formulate Faithful Personalized Fact-Checking Explanation Rewriting, which adapts an existing explanation to individual readers while preserving factual fidelity. Rather than relying on reader-written reference explanations, we learn personalized rewriting from the relative preferences of LLM-simulated readers. However, this presents two challenges: distinguishing persona-specific preferences from general explanation quality and learning beyond a limited set of predefined explanation styles. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Explanation Rewriting via Preference Learning (PERPL), a framework consisting of two components. Simulated Preference Construction derives persona-specific supervision from simulated reader preferences through cross-persona reciprocal pairing. Progressive Preference Learning first trains a lightweight rewriter on the constructed supervision and then refines it through exploration-guided preference optimization, enabling it to discover preferred explanations beyond the predefined styles. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PERPL outperforms much larger general-purpose LLMs in personalized preference alignment while maintaining high factual fidelity.
title: Same Verdict, Different Readers: Personalizing Fact-Checking Explanations from Relative Preferences
title_translated: 同一裁决，不同读者：基于相对偏好的个性化事实核查解释重写
summary_translated: 事实核查解释有助于网络用户理解某主张为何获得特定结论，但相同的解释未必能满足具有不同背景和偏好的读者。我们提出了忠实个性化事实核查解释重写任务，旨在在保持事实准确性的前提下，将现有解释适配给个体读者。不同于依赖读者撰写的参考解释，我们通过学习LLM模拟读者的相对偏好来实现个性化重写。然而，这带来了两个挑战：区分个人身份特异性偏好与一般解释质量，以及在有限预定义解释风格之外进行学习。为此，我们提出个性化解释重写偏好学习框架（PERPL），包含两个组件。模拟偏好构建通过跨身份互惠配对，从模拟读者偏好中提取身份特异性监督信号。渐进式偏好学习首先在构建的监督信号上训练轻量级重写器，然后通过探索引导的偏好优化进行精炼，使其能够发现超出预定义风格的偏好解释。大量实验表明，PERPL在个性化偏好对齐方面优于许多更大的通用大模型，同时保持高事实准确性。

summary: Structured compliance validation requires determining whether every obligation in a predefined requirement space is satisfied, violated, or unaddressed by a given document. This can be described as a coverage problem that existing retrieval and classification systems, by treating requirements as independent, are not designed to solve. We introduce \textbf{\ac{UCVE}}, a domain-agnostic framework that represents compliance requirement spaces as a \ac{CRG} and performs retrieval via spectral reranking over its reinforcement learning-weighted Laplacian. Edges between requirement nodes are learned via reinforcement learning with a traversal reward grounded in violation detection, reshaping the graph's community structure such that low-pass spectral filtering distinguishes relevant from irrelevant obligation clusters. Evaluating across three compliance domains, \ac{UCVE} averages 4.3\% matched-$K$ recall lift over flat cosine retrieval and consistently outperforms strong retrieval and graph-based baselines.
title: UCVE: Graph Structured Retrieval for Compliance Validation

title_translated: UCVE：面向合规验证的图结构检索
summary_translated: 结构化合规验证要求判断给定文档是否满足、违反或未涉及预定义需求空间中的每一项义务。这可被描述为一个覆盖问题，而现有的检索与分类系统因将需求视为独立项，无法有效解决。我们引入	extbf{쫍e{UCVE}}，一种领域无关的框架，将合规需求空间表示为	extbf{쫍e{CRG}}，并通过其强化学习加权拉普拉斯矩阵的谱重排序执行检索。需求节点间的边通过强化学习学习，以违规检测为基础的遍历奖励重塑图的社区结构，使得低通谱滤波能够区分相关与无关的义务集群。在三个合规领域上的评估显示，UCVE在匹配-K召回率上平均比平面余弦检索高出4.3%，并始终优于强检索和基于图的基线方法。

summary: Reliable evaluation of inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is important for assessing the consistency of annotation processes. While established IAA metrics such as Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, and Krippendorff's alpha are commonly applied in single-label settings, multi-label tasks require additional decisions about how full label sets, joint selections, and joint omissions should be compared.   In this work, we present Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), a flexible framework for evaluating agreement in multi-label annotation tasks. MLA preserves the full binary label vectors assigned to each item and uses average pairwise Hamming agreement, thereby accounting for both joint selections and joint omissions. Its pooled-marginal form is not a mathematically independent coefficient: it is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff's alpha with normalized Hamming distance. The framework supports pooled-marginal, Gwet AC1, and fixed-baseline normalizations, yields item-level, label-level, and corpus-level results, and includes a conditional minimum-agreement diagnostic. Through a worked example and Monte Carlo simulations, we show how the resulting values depend on label prevalence, the declared label inventory, and the selected model of expected agreement. We also provide a Python implementation. MLA thus offers a transparent and interpretable framework for multi-label agreement analysis without claiming that one normalization is universally preferable.
title: Multi-Label Agreement: A Flexible Framework for Inter-Annotator Reliability
title_translated: 多标签一致性：一种灵活的标注者间可靠性评估框架
summary_translated: 可靠的标注者间一致性（IAA）评估对于衡量标注过程的一致性至关重要。尽管Cohen's kappa、Fleiss' kappa和Krippendorff's alpha等经典IAA度量在单标签场景中被广泛使用，但多标签任务需要额外决策来确定完整标签集、联合选择和联合遗漏之间的比较方式。本文提出多标签一致性（MLA），一种用于多标签标注任务中一致性评估的灵活框架。MLA保留每个项目分配的完整二值标签向量，并使用平均成对汉明一致性，从而同时考虑联合选择和联合遗漏。其合并边际形式并非数学上独立的系数：它是标签层面Fleiss/Scott型系数的随机分歧加权平均，与使用归一化汉明距离的Krippendorff's alpha密切相关。该框架支持合并边际、Gwet AC1和固定基线归一化，可生成项目级、标签级和语料库级结果，并包含条件最小一致性诊断。通过实例分析和蒙特卡洛模拟，我们展示了所得数值如何依赖于标签出现频率、声明的标签集合以及所选预期一致性模型。我们还提供了Python实现。因此，MLA为多标签一致性分析提供了一个透明且可解释的框架，而不声称某种归一化方法在所有情况下都更优。

summary: Detecting harmful content in Arabic is challenging because of dialectal variations and the semantic overlap between different harm categories. This paper presents a two-stage approach for classifying Arabic user prompts into seven categories of harmful content. First, GLiNER is used to extract harm-related entities from each prompt. The extracted entities are then added to the original text and passed to a fine-tuned MARBERT classifier for final classification. The approach combines explicit entity information with the contextual understanding of a pretrained Arabic language model. The system was evaluated on the development set of the ArGuard 2026 shared task. The results achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.886 and an accuracy of 0.897, demonstrating promising performance in fine-grained harmful content detection. The system reported an accuracy of 0.793 and Macro-F score of 0.735 on a blind test set for subtask 1. For subtask 2, it achieved an accuracy of 0.770 and Macro-F score of 0.754. The analysis also showed that distinguishing between related categories remains challenging. These findings suggest that integrating NER with Arabic language models is a promising approach to harmful content detection.
title: REGLAT at ArGuard Shared Tasks: An Ensemble-Based Model Integrating NER for Harmful Content Detection in Arabic

title_translated: REGLAT在ArGuard共享任务中的应用：一种基于集成的阿拉伯语有害内容检测模型
summary_translated: 阿拉伯语中有害内容检测具有挑战性，主要由于方言差异以及不同危害类别之间的语义重叠。本文提出一种两阶段方法，将阿拉伯语用户提示分类为七类有害内容。首先，使用GLiNER从每个提示中提取与危害相关的实体；然后将提取的实体添加到原始文本中，并传递给微调后的MARBERT分类器进行最终分类。该方法结合了显式实体信息与预训练阿拉伯语语言模型的上下文理解能力。系统在ArGuard 2026共享任务的开发集上进行了评估，取得了0.886的宏F1分数和0.897的准确率，表明在细粒度有害内容检测方面表现良好。在子任务1的盲测集上，系统准确率为0.793，宏F分数为0.735；在子任务2上，准确率为0.770，宏F分数为0.754。分析还显示，区分相关类别仍具挑战性。这些发现表明，将命名实体识别（NER）与阿拉伯语语言模型结合是有害内容检测的一种有前景的方法。

summary: Safety alignment research for large language models (LLMs) remains concentrated on high-resource languages, leaving open how existing alignment methods perform in low-resource, culturally distinct settings. We study this question for Hausa, a language spoken by more than 200 million people across West Africa. We introduce HausaSafeLM, one of the first Hausa safety preference dataset, built from 10,000 prompts derived from PKU-SafeRLHF: 3,000 human-corrected (gold) and 7,000 machine-translated (silver) examples spanning six harm macro-categories. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, we compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and SFT followed by Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) under both data regimes, evaluating on 500 harmful and 200 benign Hausa prompts.We find that the untuned base model appears highly safe by refusal-rate metrics alone, but this reflects limited Hausa generation ability rather than genuine alignment: its refusals are almost uniformly low quality. SFT improves both refusal fluency and precision and benefits substantially from the larger, noisier silver-tier data, while DPO sharpens refusal precision but comes at a steep, largely data-invariant cost to linguistic quality. No single configuration jointly maximizes safety, helpfulness, and fluency. Our results suggest that current alignment techniques teach models when to refuse more readily than how to do so fluently in underrepresented languages, and that refusal-rate metrics alone are an unreliable signal of safety in low-resource settings.
title: Aligning Large Language Models for Safety in African Languages: A Case Study of Hausa
title_translated: 大语言模型在非洲语言中的安全对齐：以豪萨语为例的研究
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐研究目前主要集中于高资源语言，而低资源、文化独特的语言环境下的现有对齐方法表现尚不明确。本研究以西非超过两亿人使用的豪萨语为例，探讨这一问题。我们提出了HausaSafeLM，这是首个豪萨语安全偏好数据集之一，包含10,000个来自PKU-SafeRLHF的提示：其中3,000个为人工校正（黄金）样本，7,000个为机器翻译（银质）样本，涵盖六大危害宏观类别。基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型，在两种数据模式下比较监督微调（SFT）与SFT后接直接偏好优化（DPO）的效果，并在500个有害和200个良性豪萨语提示上进行评估。研究发现，未经微调的基础模型仅凭拒绝率指标看似高度安全，但这实际上反映了其豪萨语生成能力有限，而非真正的对齐：其拒绝行为几乎全部质量低下。SFT提升了拒绝的流畅性和精确性，并显著受益于更大、噪声更多的银质数据；而DPO虽提升了拒绝精确性，但代价高昂，且对语言质量造成严重损害，这种损害基本不受数据影响。没有单一配置能同时最大化安全性、有用性和流畅性。结果表明，当前对齐技术教会模型更倾向于拒绝，但并未有效提升其在代表性不足语言中流畅拒绝的能力；此外，仅依赖拒绝率指标在低资源环境中无法可靠反映安全性。

summary: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.
title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
title_translated: 决策模型作为幻觉检测的裁判
summary_translated: 大语言模型常被用作模型输出的裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge），但成本高昂且可能产生幻觉或过度自信。决策模型是一种潜在替代方案：它们返回预定义的判决结果及每类标签的概率，而非自由文本，因而更便宜、更快。本文测试了其在幻觉检测中的潜力。我们构建了五个幻觉类型（共9,852项，来自六个数据集）的二分类基准，并将五种决策模型与生成式裁判gpt-6-sol进行对比。性能强烈依赖于幻觉类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致上的平衡准确率与gpt-6-sol相当，事实错误上相差3个百分点以内，但在逻辑和指令不一致上落后4-8个百分点。决策模型的概率存在过度自信现象，虽较GPT-6模型稍轻，但区分正确与错误决策的能力一般。此外，我们发现决策模型的置信度级联机制在三种类型上优于最佳单模型1.9-3.3个百分点，并在1-3%的成本下达到或超过gpt-6-sol的表现。总体而言，决策模型是某些幻觉类型检测的实用低成本裁判，但使用前需经过验证。

summary: Knowledge distillation compresses large language models into compact students that preserve aggregate metrics, yet the mechanistic consequences of depth-reduction distillation remain largely uncharacterized. This work applies linear CKA, logit lens analysis, attention pattern decomposition, sparse autoencoder feature statistics, and activation patching to compare GPT-2 and its six-layer student DistilGPT-2 across two canonical circuits: the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit and the Greater-Than (GT) circuit. The results reveal a compression-collapse dichotomy: the IOI circuit suffers complete mechanistic collapse (DistilGPT-2: 35.2% accuracy vs. 94.8%, zero name-mover preservation), while the GT circuit survives with 87.7% task performance recovery through active remapping of the teacher's layer-9 comparison head into student layer~4 (mean Pearson r = 0.945). These findings demonstrate that circuit compressibility governs mechanistic survival under distillation, and that aggregate metrics are insufficient diagnostics for circuit integrity.
title: What Survives Distillation? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study of GPT-2 and DistilGPT-2
title_translated: 知识蒸馏中什么得以留存？对GPT-2与DistilGPT-2的机制可解释性研究
summary_translated: 知识蒸馏将大型语言模型压缩为紧凑的学生模型，以保持整体性能指标，但深度减少带来的机制后果仍缺乏充分描述。本研究采用线性CKA、logit透镜分析、注意力模式分解、稀疏自编码器特征统计和激活修补技术，对比GPT-2与其六层学生模型DistilGPT-2在两个典型电路中的表现：间接宾语识别（IOI）电路和大于比较（GT）电路。结果揭示出一种压缩-崩溃二分现象：IOI电路完全发生机制崩溃（DistilGPT-2准确率35.2% vs. 94.8%，无名称移动者保留）；而GT电路则通过将教师模型第9层比较头主动映射至学生模型第4层（平均皮尔逊相关系数r=0.945），实现了87.7%的任务性能恢复。这些发现表明，电路的可压缩性决定了其在蒸馏下的机制生存能力，而整体性能指标不足以诊断电路完整性。

summary: Synthetic text generation offers a promising approach to alleviating data scarcity in low-resource languages. However, its effectiveness is inherently limited for languages that are scarcely represented, or entirely absent, in an LLM's pretraining data. At the same time, many such languages have human-curated vocabularies that provide rich lexical and semantic information, often accompanied by grammatical information such as part-of-speech labels. In this work, we ask whether LLMs can leverage these resources to generate coherent text in extremely low-resource and unseen languages. We introduce a framework that combines human-curated vocabularies with a small number of human-written exemplars that provide syntactic signals, while sampling candidate words according to a Zipfian distribution. Across languages with varying levels of resource availability, we evaluate the generated text using lexical diversity, off-target ratio, and human judgments of fluency. Our results show that reasoning-enabled LLMs can generate fluent text even in extremely low-resource languages, with particularly strong results at the sentence level and promising performance at the paragraph level. Our findings highlight a practical pathway for bootstrapping synthetic data in low-resource languages, expanding the amount of usable text even when existing digital resources are extremely limited. Our source code is available at https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text.
title: Text Generation in Low-Resource Languages Using Human-Curated Vocabularies
title_translated: 利用人工整理词表生成低资源语言文本
summary_translated: 合成文本生成为缓解低资源语言的数据稀缺问题提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，对于在大型语言模型预训练数据中极少或完全缺失的语言，其有效性受到内在限制。与此同时，许多此类语言拥有由人工整理的词表，提供了丰富的词汇和语义信息，通常还包含词性标注等语法信息。本文探讨大型语言模型是否可以利用这些资源在极低资源且未见过的语言中生成连贯文本。我们提出一个框架，将人工整理的词表与少量人工编写的示例相结合，以提供句法信号，同时根据Zipf分布采样候选词。我们在不同资源水平的语言上评估生成文本的词汇多样性、非目标比率以及人类对流畅性的判断。结果表明，具备推理能力的大型语言模型即使在极低资源语言中也能生成流畅文本，尤其在句子层面表现优异，在段落层面也展现出良好性能。研究结果揭示了一条实用的路径，用于在低资源语言中构建合成数据，即使现有数字资源极为有限，也能扩展可用文本量。源代码已公开于 https://github.com/michaelsinanta/vocab2text。

summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
title: Hierarchical Low-Rank Reparameterization for Parameter-Efficient

title_translated: 参数高效微调的分层低秩重参数化方法
summary_translated: 参数高效微调（PEFT）方法通过引入少量可训练参数来适应大型模型。然而，我们发现这些参数仍存在冗余，可在保持强任务性能的前提下进一步压缩。为此，我们提出一种新颖的分层低秩重参数化方法。其核心思想是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重新组织为近似方阵，并通过低秩分解表达，该过程可递归应用，形成多层级结构，逐级压缩因子，从而大幅减少可训练参数数量。我们在实验中将该重参数化方法与LoRA、DoRA、MoSA和RaSA结合使用。在LLaMA-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上评估常识推理能力，并在LLaMA-3.1-8B上进行GSM8K数学推理实验。在相近的可训练参数预算下，我们的方法与LoRA或DoRA结合时表现更优。此外，当原始方法的参数量压缩约一个数量级时，我们的方法仍能保持具有竞争力的任务性能，甚至在八个常识推理基准上的平均准确率超过对应基线。

summary: Multilingual evaluation benchmarks are the primary instrument for assessing whether large language models generalize beyond English, yet the adequacy of these benchmarks has received little systematic scrutiny. We present a data-driven audit of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 languages, organized around three pillars: coverage, representativeness, and rigor. Our analysis reveals that coverage is wide but thin with 36% of evaluated languages appearing in only a single benchmark, entire regions (Oceania, the Americas, Central Asia) are near-zero, and a stark task equity gap leaves low-resource languages evaluated on only 1-3 task categories versus 14 for high-resource languages. Representativeness is structurally compromised: translation from English remains the dominant construction strategy where 56% of all dataset-language instances are translated introducing artifacts and English-centric framing, while culturally grounded content is concentrated in a handful of community-driven benchmarks with narrow language scope. The ecosystem thus forces a trade-off between breadth and validity. Rigor is undermined by benchmark contamination, including translated benchmark leakage and parallel corpus overlap that evade surface-form detection. We synthesize these findings into concrete recommendations for building evaluation frameworks that are natively constructed, culturally grounded, contamination-aware, and designed to serve the communities whose languages they claim to evaluate. The dashboard with all the metadata collected can be found at https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals.
title: The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World

title_translated: 自然语言处理领域多语言上下文评估的现状与未来
summary_translated: 多语言评估基准是衡量大型语言模型是否超越英语泛化能力的主要工具，但这些基准的充分性却很少得到系统性审视。我们对51个近期的多语言基准进行了数据驱动的审计，涵盖242个数据集和219种语言，围绕覆盖度、代表性与严谨性三个核心维度展开。分析显示：覆盖度虽广但浅薄，36%的被评估语言仅出现在单一基准中，整个大洋洲、美洲及中亚地区几乎为零；任务公平性差距显著，低资源语言仅被评估1-3个任务类别，而高资源语言则达14个。代表性方面存在结构性缺陷：翻译自英语仍是主要构建策略，56%的数据集-语言实例为翻译而来，引入了偏差和以英语为中心的表述；而文化相关的内容仅集中在少数社区驱动的基准中，语言范围狭窄。因此，该生态系统迫使我们在广度与有效性之间做出权衡。严谨性因基准污染而受损，包括翻译泄露和并行语料重叠等问题，难以通过表面形式检测。我们据此提出具体建议，倡导构建原生构建、文化扎根、抗污染且服务于其所声称评估语言社区的评估框架。所有收集的元数据仪表板可访问 https://aka.ms/multilingual-evals。

summary: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.
title: Self-Keyed In-Parameter Memorization for External Memory-Free Dialogue Recall in Frozen Language Models
title_translated: 无外部记忆的冻结语言模型中自键式参数内记忆对话召回
summary_translated: 大型语言模型将对话内容存储在模型外部的存储中，随着对话持续而不断增长。本研究假设一个环境：语言模型既无外部记忆，也无对未来问题及其答案的先验知识。研究动机在于探索是否可将对话内容存储于模型参数中，并在后续回答相关问题。为此，我们提出自键式参数内记忆（SKIM），一种闭式方法：模型为每一轮对话自动生成多个问题，并将这些问题作为键写入自身参数中，以供后续检索该轮对话内容。为每轮对话生成多种变体问题，使得用户问题即使表述不同也能匹配到相应键，其答案仅从模型参数中召回，无需任何外部存储。在五个语言模型上的评估表明，SKIM能够从后续用户问题中召回大部分存储的对话轮次，且完全依赖模型参数完成回答，无需外部存储。

summary: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items as semantic identifiers (SIDs) and autoregressively generates the next item's SID from interaction history. However, most methods assign the same SID length to all items despite highly unequal interaction frequencies. This uniform design repeatedly incurs the cost of fine-grained codes for popular items, while shortening codes to reduce this cost also compresses the semantic representations of long-tail items. Inspired by the compact forms of frequent expressions in natural language, we propose JevRec to encode items as variable-length words and generate the next item from interaction context. Linguistic encoding retains frequency-dependent semantic prefixes from shared codebooks, producing shorter SIDs for popular items and richer descriptions for long-tail items. Yet predicting a sequence-level length and generating token-level content impose different optimization requirements that may conflict under a shared output head. Our Jev-like decision modeling component therefore predicts a length distribution with a dedicated head and generates content conditioned on length through a separate head while sharing the interaction-history representation. Experiments on three public datasets show that JevRec outperforms all compared baselines across the evaluated recommendation metrics. Further analyses show lower training and inference time than TIGER and reduced gradient conflict between length and content prediction.
title: JevRec: Linguistic Encoding with Jev-like Decision Modeling for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
title_translated: JevRec：基于类Jev决策建模的LLM生成推荐中的语言编码
summary_translated: 生成推荐（GR）将物品表示为语义标识符（SIDs），并根据交互历史自回归生成下一个物品的SID。然而，大多数方法对所有物品采用相同的SID长度，尽管交互频率差异极大。这种统一设计反复为热门物品付出细粒度编码的成本，而缩短编码以降低此成本又会压缩长尾物品的语义表示。受自然语言中频繁表达的紧凑形式启发，我们提出JevRec，将物品编码为可变长度词，并从交互上下文中生成下一个物品。语言编码保留了来自共享词典的频率相关语义前缀，使热门物品的SID更短，长尾物品的描述更丰富。然而，序列级长度预测与标记级内容生成具有不同的优化需求，可能在共享输出头下产生冲突。因此，我们的类Jev决策建模组件通过专用头预测长度分布，并通过独立头在给定长度条件下生成内容，同时共享交互历史表示。在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，JevRec在所有评估推荐指标上均优于对比基线。进一步分析显示，其训练和推理时间低于TIGER，且长度与内容预测之间的梯度冲突更小。

summary: Multimodal transformer models have driven unprecedented performance breakthroughs in modern document understanding. However, the inherent black-box nature of these models remains a major obstacle to their safe deployment in high-stakes sectors. Despite significant progress in explainability for vision and language tasks, explainable AI (XAI) research tailored to multimodal document understanding has received little attention. To address this gap, we present \ourframework{}, the first comprehensive explainability framework that adapts existing XAI methods and evaluation metrics to the multimodal (text, layout, and image) document understanding context, while introducing efficient multi-target adaptations of both methods and metrics for domain-specific tasks such as semantic entity recognition. Using \ourframework{}, we systematically evaluate 13 XAI methods across 3 document understanding tasks, 8 datasets, 4 models, and 17 evaluation metrics, and find that only a few methods perform consistently across all evaluation criteria, with Occlusion emerging as the most faithful and interpretable method overall. Through a dedicated meta-evaluation, we observe moderate to strong agreement among several faithfulness and complexity metrics while identifying certain ones that produce unreliable results. Finally, through multiple dataset-wide diagnostic analyses, we uncover key insights into model behavior, including the contribution of individual modalities across tasks and labels, spatial attribution patterns around target entities, and potential dataset biases. Overall, this work serves as both a benchmark and a practical guide for future XAI research in multimodal document understanding. To support reproducibility, we publicly release our code at https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval/.
title: DocXEval: A Systematic Evaluation of Explainability in Multimodal Document Understanding
title_translated: DocXEval：多模态文档理解可解释性的系统评估
summary_translated: 多模态Transformer模型在现代文档理解中取得了前所未有的性能突破。然而，这些模型固有的黑箱特性仍然是其在高风险领域安全部署的主要障碍。尽管在视觉和语言任务的可解释性方面取得了显著进展，但针对多模态文档理解的可解释AI（XAI）研究仍鲜有关注。为填补这一空白，我们提出了\ourframework{}，这是首个全面的可解释性框架，将现有的XAI方法和评估指标适配到多模态（文本、版式和图像）文档理解场景，并引入了针对特定任务（如语义实体识别）的高效多目标方法与指标适应机制。利用\ourframework{}，我们在3个文档理解任务、8个数据集、4个模型和17个评估指标上系统评估了13种XAI方法，发现仅有少数方法在所有评估标准下表现一致，其中遮挡法（Occlusion）总体上是最忠实且可解释的方法。通过专门的元评估，我们观察到多个忠实度和复杂度指标之间存在中等到强的一致性，同时识别出某些产生不可靠结果的指标。最后，通过多次跨数据集的诊断分析，我们揭示了关于模型行为的关键洞见，包括各模态在不同任务和标签中的贡献、目标实体周围的空间归因模式以及潜在的数据集偏差。总体而言，本工作既可作为多模态文档理解中未来XAI研究的基准，也提供了实用指南。为支持可复现性，我们已公开发布代码：https://github.com/saifullah3396/docxeval。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemGallery with four open- and closed-source backbones show consistent improvements over representative memory systems, with macro-F1 gains of 2.23-3.14 points. On LoCoMo, TrawMem improves the LLM-Judge score over SimpleMem by 4.07 and 4.31 percentage points on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, respectively, while requiring approximately 12.8% and 5.1% fewer context tokens, respectively.
title: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
title_translated: TrawMem：将智能体记忆重构为面向任务的角色自适应工作区
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖记忆系统来利用长期交互，但现有系统通常仅根据与当前查询的相关性检索记忆，并将其作为上下文证据使用。然而，相关性本身并不能刻画记忆对任务解决的实际贡献：同一记忆在不同任务中可能扮演不同角色，例如直接支持答案，或连接到语义相关性较弱但信息必要的互补记忆。因此，我们重新将智能体记忆系统构想为面向任务的角色自适应工作区，其中记忆根据其任务导向的角色和关系进行选择与组织。基于这一视角，我们提出TrawMem，该方法将交互历史组织为局部线程，并通过分配角色和联合选择互补记忆来构建面向任务的工作区。在LoCoMo和MemGallery上的实验表明，TrawMem在四种开源与闭源骨干模型上均显著优于代表性记忆系统，宏F1得分提升2.23至3.14个百分点。在LoCoMo上，TrawMem相较于SimpleMem，在Qwen3.5-9B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上的LLM-Judge得分分别提升了4.07和4.31个百分点，同时分别减少了约12.8%和5.1%的上下文token消耗。

summary: When the sources retrieved for a query disagree, the right response depends on why they disagree: a question with several valid answers, a contested topic, stale information and a false source each call for different behaviour. Cattan et al. (2025) showed that telling a generator the conflict type improves its responses by about 24 points, but that predicting the type is hard even for frontier LLMs. We study whether typed decision models, which return probabilities over fixed options in a single forward pass instead of generating text, can do this classification fast and cheaply. Using the CONFLICTS benchmark and the original paper's prompt verbatim, we evaluate all 11 decision models served by one commercial inference gateway, from 7 providers, against Gemini models on identical inputs. Asked directly, the decision models reach 50.0--67.0% accuracy; 10 of the 11 match or exceed Gemini 2.5 Flash, the paper's model (61.3%), at 4--39x lower billed cost (2 were free) and 2.6--6.0x lower latency. The current Gemini 3.8 Flash (70.0%) is significantly more accurate than 8 of them, but sending each decision model's least confident quarter of queries to it gives a cascade statistically tied with it for 8 of the 11, at 25--37% of its cost. End to end, answers generated with the types of 10 of the 11 follow the expected behaviour as often as with the LLM's types. Decomposing the taxonomy into yes/no questions lowers accuracy for every model, and a repair fitted on one model does not transfer. Pre-specified diagnostics show that dates play no measurable role and that sensitivity to source order varies widely between models. Decision models detect a planted false source less reliably than the LLM as hard labels, but their probabilities still separate planted from clean sources. We release code, prompts and all model outputs at https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing.
title: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG

title_translated: 我们需要一个LLM来判断来源冲突的原因吗？RAG中知识冲突分类的决策模型
summary_translated: 当为查询检索到的来源存在分歧时，正确的响应取决于它们为何冲突：具有多个有效答案的问题、争议性话题、过时信息和虚假来源各自需要不同的应对策略。Cattan等人（2025）表明，告知生成器冲突类型可使响应质量提升约24分，但即使是前沿LLM也难以准确预测冲突类型。我们研究了经过类型化训练的决策模型——在单次前向传播中返回固定选项的概率分布而非生成文本——是否能快速且低成本地完成此类分类。使用CONFLICTS基准和原论文的提示原文，我们在相同输入下评估了由11个商业推理网关提供的来自7家供应商的全部决策模型，并与Gemini模型进行对比。直接提问时，决策模型的准确率在50.0%至67.0%之间；10个模型达到或超过原论文所用的Gemini 2.5 Flash模型（61.3%）的性能，成本降低4至39倍（其中两个免费），延迟降低2.6至6.0倍。当前的Gemini 3.8 Flash（70.0%）显著更准确，但将每个决策模型最不自信的四分之一查询发送给它后，形成级联结构，有8个模型在统计上与之持平，成本仅为原模型的25%至37%。端到端来看，11个模型中有10个使用其分类结果生成的答案，其行为与使用LLM分类结果时一致。将分类体系分解为是/否问题会降低所有模型的准确率，且在一个模型上拟合的修复无法迁移。预设诊断显示，日期在分类中无明显作用，而各模型对来源顺序的敏感性差异极大。决策模型检测植入的虚假来源的能力不如LLM作为硬标签时可靠，但其概率仍能有效区分虚假与干净来源。我们已将代码、提示及所有模型输出发布于 https://github.com/Parv17k/decision-models-conflict-typing。

summary: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.
title: Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque

title_translated: 开发巴斯克语语音语言模型
summary_translated: 尽管近期大语言模型的发展推动了多模态交互的实现，但少数语言仍面临难以跟上技术进步的困境。本工作首次提出面向巴斯克语的开放语音语言模型，专为低延迟、端到端语音交互设计。该系统基于LLaMA-Omni架构，采用Latxa模型作为主干，通过微调多个模块，将其中的巴斯克语能力迁移至语音模态。为应对数据稀缺问题，我们将英文VoiceAssistant-400K语料库翻译成巴斯克语，并使用巴斯克语语音合成系统生成音频。评估结果显示系统具备可行性：内容质量得分为3.86/5，语音可懂度词错误率为9.94%，音频质量UTMOS得分为3.07。本研究表明，即使在资源匮乏的语言中，也可通过模块化架构和合成数据构建先进的语音交互系统。

summary: Many AI systems need to find every relevant items in a large collection and then organize what they found. The standard way to do this is to tag each item with labels from a curated vocabulary and search on those labels. Those labels are useful for organizing results, but searching on them misses items that do not fit a label and returns too much when labels are broad. We compare this approach with an embedding-based approach: find candidates by meaning using text embeddings, then have a language model keep only the relevant ones. In a corpus of 7,354 randomized trials, label search found 45% of the evidence a systematic review would include, while the new approach found 92%, at a cost per query that rises with search depth. These results support a two-stage architecture that combines broad candidate retrieval with query-specific evidence filtering.
title: Nothing Left Behind: Finding Evidence from a Large Randomized Evaluation Corpus
title_translated: 不留遗漏：从大规模随机评估语料库中寻找证据
summary_translated: 许多AI系统需要在大规模集合中找出所有相关项目，并对所发现的内容进行组织。传统方法是为每个项目打上精心策划词汇表中的标签，然后基于这些标签进行搜索。这些标签有助于结果组织，但基于标签的搜索会遗漏不符合标签的项目，且当标签范围过宽时会产生过多冗余结果。我们比较了这种方法与基于嵌入的方法：先通过文本嵌入按语义查找候选项，再由语言模型筛选出真正相关的部分。在包含7,354个随机试验的语料库中，标签搜索仅找到了系统综述应包含的45%的证据，而新方法找到了92%，尽管每次查询的成本随搜索深度增加而上升。这些结果支持一种两阶段架构：先进行广泛候选检索，再进行查询特定的证据过滤。

summary: Web systems increasingly predict users' decisions from what users say, yet when interests partly conflict, users may promise to cooperate to win the other side's cooperation and then not do so. Sales or service agents that rely on such promises may grant concessions to users who then do not keep their promises, at a cost to the party they represent. We test how LLMs combine users' statements with decision records to predict users' decisions, using 1,260 rounds in which 42 users played a repeated prisoner's dilemma-style game with five agents, each prompted to express a dominant Big Five trait, and could talk with the agent before every decision. Across eight open-weight LLMs, predictions from decision records separated cooperation from defection well (AUC = .80), and adding dialogue brought no detectable gain. With dialogue, predictions agreed with users' statements more often, and errors concentrated on rounds in which users broke their statements: accuracy on rounds with a statement barely changed (.73 to .74), while it rose on kept statements (.76 to .95) and fell sharply on broken ones (.65 to .17). Predictions weighted statements more heavily than users' behavior warranted: when users stated a decision they had not yet made in that game, the predicted probability of keeping it rose from .13 to .69, whereas users kept .40 of such statements. Users' decisions also varied with the agent they faced, but predictions hardly reflected this: users cooperated more with the Agreeableness agent than with the Extraversion agent (70.6% vs. 54.5%), whereas predicted cooperation was nearly identical (64.5% vs. 63.1%). Users also cooperated more with an agent when they themselves scored higher on that agent's trait, whereas predicted cooperation barely changed with these scores. Dialogue-based predictions should therefore weigh users' statements by their earlier decisions and the agent they face.
title: Words or Deeds? How LLMs Predict Users' Decisions in Human-Agent Dialogue
title_translated: 话语还是行动？大语言模型如何预测人机对话中用户的行为决策
summary_translated: 网络系统越来越多地根据用户所说的话来预测其决策，但在利益部分冲突的情况下，用户可能为了赢得对方合作而承诺合作，之后却不履行承诺。依赖此类承诺的销售或服务代理可能会向未兑现承诺的用户让步，从而损害其所代表方的利益。我们测试了大语言模型如何结合用户的陈述与决策记录来预测其行为，在42名用户与五个代理进行重复囚徒困境式游戏的1260轮实验中，每个代理被提示表现出一种主导的大五人格特质，且在每次决策前可与代理交流。在八种开放权重的大语言模型中，仅基于决策记录的预测已能较好地区分合作与背叛（AUC = 0.80），而加入对话信息并未带来显著提升。在有对话的情况下，预测结果更倾向于与用户陈述一致，错误主要集中在用户违背自己陈述的回合：对于陈述基本不变的回合，准确率从0.73升至0.74；对于坚持陈述的回合，准确率从0.76升至0.95；而对于违背陈述的回合，准确率则从0.65骤降至0.17。预测过度重视用户的陈述，而非其实际行为：当用户陈述一个尚未做出的决定时，预测其保持该决定的概率从0.13上升至0.69，而真实保持率仅为0.40。此外，用户的行为还受所面对代理的影响，但预测几乎未反映这一差异：用户与宜人性代理合作的比例（70.6%）远高于与外向性代理合作的比例（54.5%），但预测的合作概率却几乎相同（64.5% vs. 63.1%）。用户在自身得分较高的人格特质对应代理面前也更愿意合作，但预测对此类变化反应极小。因此，基于对话的预测应根据用户过往决策及所面对的代理来调整对陈述的权重。

summary: Knowledge improvement in large language models is shifting from predefined knowledge incorporation pipelines toward evaluation-guided updating. Existing methods use evaluation to localize model-specific knowledge weaknesses and guide targeted post-training. However, identifying what to improve does not necessarily provide sufficient information for deciding how to improve it. The same localized weakness can be compatible with distinct operational knowledge states: the relevant knowledge may be unavailable, available but difficult to access reliably, or accessible but ineffective for downstream use. We call this ambiguity knowledge-state aliasing. When compatible states favor different interventions, greater diagnostic resolution alone is insufficient for intervention selection. Moreover, model updates can change the underlying knowledge state before the observed weakness disappears, such that an intervention appropriate in one round may no longer address the bottleneck in the next. To address these challenges, we propose Recursive Knowledge Improvement (RKI), which formulates knowledge improvement as a sequential, state-aware intervention process. RKI organizes knowledge into graph-structured units that provide a shared basis for diagnostic evaluation and targeted intervention across rounds. At each round, RKI localizes knowledge weaknesses, estimates the model's operational knowledge state from diagnostic evidence and intervention history, selects a corresponding intervention, and re-evaluates the updated model before determining the next intervention. On HotpotEval and SafeInternalEval, RKI outperforms existing knowledge incorporation methods by 18.41 points on average. Further analyses show that knowledge states provide additional guidance for intervention selection beyond weakness localization and can change across model updates even when the observed weakness persists.
title: Weakness Localization Is Not Enough: State-Aware Recursive Knowledge Improvement for Large Language Models
title_translated: 弱点定位不足：面向大语言模型的状态感知递归知识改进方法
summary_translated: 大语言模型的知识改进正从预定义的知识整合流程转向评估引导的更新机制。现有方法利用评估来定位模型特定的知识弱点，并指导针对性的后训练优化。然而，识别需要改进的内容并不足以提供如何改进的充分信息。相同的弱点可能对应不同的操作知识状态：相关知识可能不可用、可用但难以可靠访问，或虽可访问但对下游任务无效。我们称这种模糊性为‘知识状态混淆’。当兼容状态偏好不同干预方式时，仅提高诊断分辨率不足以支持干预选择。此外，模型更新可能在观察到的弱点消失前改变底层知识状态，导致某一轮合适的干预在下一轮已不再解决瓶颈问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出递归知识改进（RKI），将知识改进建模为一个序列化、状态感知的干预过程。RKI将知识组织为图结构单元，为多轮诊断评估和针对性干预提供共享基础。每轮中，RKI定位知识弱点，根据诊断证据和干预历史估计模型的操作知识状态，选择相应干预措施，并在确定下一步干预前重新评估更新后的模型。在HotpotEval和SafeInternalEval上，RKI平均优于现有知识整合方法18.41分。进一步分析表明，知识状态在弱点定位之外提供了额外的干预选择指导，且即使观察到的弱点持续存在，知识状态也可能随模型更新而发生变化。

summary: Controlling the personality of a language model usually relies on written profiles or named trait categories, so it can only express what an author writes down or what a taxonomy names. We instead propose Personality Latents (PL), which learn a latent for each person from their own writing, with no personality labels and no authored profile, and inject it into a frozen language model as a soft prefix. Following generative latent optimization, each training person receives a free latent that is optimized through the frozen model itself, while an encoder learns to predict these latents so that a new person needs only one forward pass, with optional refinement at test time. We evaluate on held-out people by having the conditioned model answer neutral and interview questions and reading personality from its answers with scorers trained on real human writing. On the MBTI axes PL reaches an AUC of , ahead of persona embedding and prompt-based baselines under identical settings, and the ranking holds when the answers are scored in three different embedding spaces. A latent learned with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct also transfers personality to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct through a new adapter alone.
title: Personality Latents: Conditioning Frozen Language Models on Individuals from Their Own Writing
title_translated: 人格潜变量：基于个体自身写作内容对冻结语言模型进行个性化控制
summary_translated: 通常控制语言模型的人格特征依赖于书面档案或命名的性格类别，因此只能表达作者写下的内容或分类体系所命名的内容。我们提出人格潜变量（PL），通过个体自身的写作内容学习每个人对应的潜在表示，无需人格标签或人工撰写的个人档案，并将其作为软前缀注入冻结的语言模型中。在生成潜变量优化的基础上，每个训练个体获得一个自由潜变量，该潜变量通过冻结模型自身进行优化，同时一个编码器学习预测这些潜变量，使得新个体只需一次前向传播即可生成人格表示，测试时可选进行微调。我们在保留人员上进行评估，让条件化模型回答中性问题和访谈问题，并使用基于真实人类写作训练的评分器从中读取人格特征。在MBTI维度上，PL达到AUC表现优于人格嵌入和基于提示的基线方法，在相同设置下排名一致，且在三种不同嵌入空间中评分结果仍保持领先。使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct学习的潜变量还可通过新适配器将人格特征迁移至Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

summary: Reading "While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods" requires giving up the analysis in which "the deer" is the object of "hunted". People who have just read such a sentence still produce more transitive structures, so the abandoned analysis primes later language. We ask whether language models keep using an analysis they have abandoned, and what in the model carries it. In 24 open models from 124M to 70B parameters, a garden-path sentence leaves two traces in the context. A residue of the abandoned analysis raises later object attachment, by about three quarters of the effect of a sentence in which the noun phrase really is an object, and it appears in sampled text, on held-out and human-normed items and for a second type of garden path. An adaptation toward the resolved structure scales with the sentence's disambiguation error and acts mainly on comprehension-like measures. Activation patching separates the two. Later text reads the residue from the role information in the noun phrase's states, which were computed under the object analysis before the disambiguation, and replacing these states removes almost all of the residue in the 32B and 70B models. The adaptation is read from the states that processed the disambiguation. Overridden statements show the same persistence (a corrected value keeps pulling later predictions in 8 of 9 models), and in most models the pull is carried by the positions after the statement. Finally, the human paradigm transfers only with controls for punctuation, because the models also write garden-path sentences themselves, which reverses the paradigm's raw statistic.
title: Language Models Keep Abandoned Analyses: Residue and Adaptation after Garden-Path Sentences
title_translated: 语言模型保留被放弃的分析：路径陷阱句后的残留与适应现象
summary_translated: 阅读“当男人追捕鹿时，它跑进了树林”这类路径陷阱句，需要放弃‘鹿’是‘追捕’宾语的分析。刚读完此类句子的人仍更倾向于产生主动结构，说明被放弃的分析会持续影响后续语言处理。我们探究语言模型是否也会保留已被放弃的分析，以及模型中何种成分承载了这种残留。在24个参数规模从124M到70B的开放模型中，路径陷阱句会在上下文中留下两个痕迹。被放弃分析的残留会提升后续的宾语附着概率，约为真实宾语句效应的四分之三，且出现在采样文本中，涵盖保留样本、人类规范项以及另一类路径陷阱句。朝向正确结构的适应作用随句子歧义消除误差而增强，主要影响理解类指标。激活修补实验分离出这两种效应。残留信号来自名词短语状态中的角色信息，这些状态是在歧义消解前按宾语分析计算得出的，替换这些状态几乎完全消除了32B和70B模型中的残留。适应信号则来自处理歧义消解的状态。被覆盖的陈述也表现出同样的持久性（修正值在8/9个模型中仍持续影响后续预测），且在大多数模型中，这种影响由陈述后的位置承担。最后，人类范式仅在控制标点符号后才可转移，因为模型自身也会写出路径陷阱句，这逆转了范式的原始统计结果。

summary: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.
title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
title_translated: DocSkill：面向多语言多跳文档问答的技能集成型智能体推理框架
summary_translated: 多语言多跳文档问答（MMHop-DocQA）要求在复杂布局、多页文档和多种语言之间定位并整合证据。现有方法包括单次处理和自适应工具使用，但学习协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证仍具挑战性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DocSkill，一种具有学习型技能调度策略的智能体框架，用于自适应证据获取与推理。该策略根据不断演化的证据状态选择、重访或跳过技能。为构建技能调度的监督信号，采用有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）离线探索替代技能轨迹。这些轨迹为监督微调（SFT）提供示范数据，并为直接偏好优化（DPO）生成偏好对。我们进一步引入MMHop-DocBench，一个包含10种语言和8个文档领域的多语言多跳文档问答数据集，包含6万条问答对。其HopGen流水线构建层次化页面元素图，以推导可追溯的跨页证据路径，并生成带有页面级和元素级证据标注的有依据问答对。实验表明，使用Qwen3-VL-8B的DocSkill在MMHop-DocBench上达到41.0的准确率和49.2的F1值，分别超过最强基线5.5和6.3分，并在MMLongBench-Doc和DocBench上取得具有竞争力的表现。

summary: Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. It also achieves the highest final scores on all four selected TRACE tasks and maintains or improves earlier-task performance relative to post-acquisition levels in a sequence spanning financial question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization.
title: CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
title_translated: CAMR：面向大语言模型持续学习的兼容性感知记忆重放
summary_translated: 持续学习要求大语言模型在获取新知识和能力的同时保留已有学习内容。微调和重放支持知识获取与保留，但决定是否需要对新样本进行监督以及应重访哪些历史样本仍是一个挑战。我们提出兼容性感知记忆重放（CAMR），一种自适应框架，联合控制当前样本的监督和历史重放。CAMR结合兼容性检查与学习得到的记忆门，指导在线策略选择三种行为：使用通用重放学习新样本、联合强化兼容的相关样本，以及跳过已验证掌握的重复样本的直接监督。该策略在有限的每次到达重放预算下，从知识获取、保留和训练成本反馈中学习。我们在Qwen3-8B-Base上评估了CAMR在持续事实更新及跨任务、跨领域学习中的表现。在WikiBigEdit数据集上，CAMR在3K至100K个事实范围内始终优于对比方法，在仅3K事实后即达到93.66%的原始匹配率，并在100K事实后超越全历史重放（LoRA）方法。此外，它在所有四个选定的TRACE任务中均取得最高最终得分，并相对于后续学习水平保持或提升了先前任务的表现，涵盖金融问答、数学推理、代码生成和摘要等多个任务序列。

summary: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context. We evaluate this harness on 25 business-project drafts expanded into formal reports, the result shows that the defensive propositions decreased from 59 to 2, which is a 96.61\% reduction, no unsupported factual additions were identified while the source-claim retention rises from 80.35% to 93.12%.
title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections
title_translated: 通过隔离异议减少智能体过度防御性写作的工具
summary_translated: 在扩展报告时，使用智能体写作可能会引入比原文更强的主张，随后又加以否定，这种现象称为过度防御性写作。我们认为这可能是因为智能体是在为应对对抗性AI评审者而非人类读者写作。防御性语境也可能影响后续结果，若仅通过提示词简单禁止防御性写作，反而可能产生副作用。为减少过度防御性写作，我们设计了一种工具，将评审者、过滤器和写作者三者分离。写作者智能体仅接收由独立过滤器选择的问题。我们在25份商业项目草稿扩展为正式报告的任务中评估该工具，结果显示防御性主张从59个降至2个，减少了96.61%，未发现任何未经支持的事实添加，同时源主张保留率从80.35%提升至93.12%。

summary: Reasoning language models answer math problems by writing long chains of thought, and sampling many chains per problem and taking a majority vote raises accuracy at a large cost in generated text. A popular way to cut that cost scores each chain by the model's confidence in each token it writes, where a token is a word or part of a word. The method averages this confidence over a sliding window of 2048 tokens and keeps or stops chains based on the lowest average. We treat the confidence, recorded token by token, as a signal in the sense of audio or radio, and examine the method with standard signal-processing tools such as spectral analysis and statistical tests for detecting a sudden change. We sampled 16 chains for each of 500 problems from two math benchmarks with a small open reasoning model. The windowed-minimum score turns out to measure mostly how long a chain is. Ranking chains by length alone does as well as or better than the confidence score, and once length is accounted for the score carries no information about correctness. Signal processing explains why: the minimum of a longer stretch of a slowly drifting signal is lower by chance alone, and the confidence signal drifts slowly enough that this effect dominates. The spectrum does hold a small signal that length does not explain, since incorrect chains carry more rapid token-to-token fluctuation, but it is too weak to improve the vote. For stopping chains early, neither the sliding average nor a classical change detector beats the simpler choice of sampling fewer chains.
title: Is Token Confidence Just Chain Length? A Signal-Processing Audit of Reasoning Traces
title_translated: 思维链中的标记置信度是否仅由链长决定？对推理轨迹的信号处理审计
summary_translated: 推理型语言模型通过撰写长串思维链来解答数学问题，每道题采样多条链并取多数投票可显著提高准确率，但代价是生成大量文本。一种流行的方法是根据模型对每个生成标记（词或词的一部分）的置信度评分来筛选链，即对滑动窗口内2048个标记的置信度取平均值，依据最低平均值决定保留或终止链。我们将逐标记记录的置信度视为音频或无线电中的信号，采用标准信号处理工具如频谱分析和突变检测统计检验进行分析。我们从两个数学基准测试中，使用小型开源推理模型对500道题各采样16条链。结果表明，滑动窗口最小值评分主要反映链的长度：仅按长度排序即可达到或超过置信度评分效果；一旦考虑长度因素，置信度评分不再携带关于正确性的信息。信号处理解释原因：较长的缓慢漂移信号其最小值因偶然性更低，而置信度信号漂移足够慢，导致此效应占主导。频谱中虽存在一小部分长度无法解释的信号（因错误链具有更快速的标记间波动），但强度太弱，无法提升投票效果。对于提前终止链而言，滑动平均或经典变化检测器均不如简单地减少采样链数有效。

summary: Modern language models are trained on far more language than children experience, but we know much less about learning from small, naturalistic datasets. We train small GPT-2 models on transcripts of speech with children from dense home recordings (BabyView) and on synthetic child-directed dialogue (TinyDialogues), varying the amount, source, and diversity of training data. Models trained on one child's language environment predict that environment substantially better than other children's environments. Much of this specialization is lexical and distributional: a simple 5-gram model reproduces the cross-child pattern (r=.91). Training on data from multiple children clearly improves prediction of pooled held-out language relative to training on a single child's input without a similarly clear improvement on grammatical benchmarks. Across data sizes, naturalistic and synthetic training inputs also produce different grammatical and lexical-semantic patterns, with important differences between grammatical phenomena. Together, these results show that small-data language learning depends not only on how much language a model sees, but on which environments it comes from and how well that input matches what the model is asked to predict.
title: Specialization, Diversity, and Scaling in Child-Scale Language Models

title_translated: 儿童规模语言模型中的专业化、多样性与扩展性
summary_translated: 现代语言模型所训练的语言量远超儿童实际接触的范围，但我们对小规模、自然语料下的学习机制了解甚少。我们使用来自密集家庭录音（BabyView）的儿童口语转录本和合成的儿童导向对话（TinyDialogues）数据，训练小型GPT-2模型，系统调整训练数据的数量、来源和多样性。在单一儿童语言环境上训练的模型能显著更好地预测该环境，而非其他儿童的环境。这种专业化主要体现在词汇和分布层面：一个简单的5元语法模型即可复现跨儿童模式（相关系数r=0.91）。在多个儿童数据上训练明显提升了对合并保留语言的预测能力，但在语法基准上的提升并不明显。在不同数据规模下，自然语料与合成语料产生的语法和词义模式存在显著差异，尤其在语法现象方面。这些结果表明，小数据语言学习不仅取决于模型看到的语言量，更取决于其训练环境来源及其与目标预测任务的匹配程度。

summary: The Asch conformity experiment has recently gained considerable attention as a way of measuring conformity in large language models (LLMs). While previous studies have focused on demonstrating conformity in LLMs, our work adds a further quantitative layer to this approach. Instead of sampling a frontier LLM on a suite of questions, our approach samples a single question repeatedly, leveraging the probabilistic nature of LLMs to produce a distribution of answers. In doing so, we can compare the distributions of answers before and after the model is presented with the manufactured consensus. Our experiments confirm that frontier LLMs do conform, reinforcing prior literature, and, through our distribution-to-distribution comparisons, provide additional quantitative data on the conditions that lead to conformity and the degree to which it occurs.
title: A Quantitative Approach to Asch Conformity in Frontier Large Language Models
title_translated: 前沿大语言模型中阿施从众现象的定量研究
summary_translated: 阿施从众实验近年来被广泛用于衡量大语言模型（LLM）的从众倾向。尽管以往研究集中于证明LLM存在从众行为，我们的工作在此基础上增加了定量分析维度。不同于以往对一系列问题采样单次回答，我们采用重复采样同一问题的方式，利用LLM的概率特性生成答案分布。由此，我们可以比较模型在接收到人为制造的一致意见前后，答案分布的变化。实验结果证实前沿LLM确实表现出从众行为，进一步支持了既有文献，并通过分布到分布的对比，提供了关于从众发生条件及程度的额外量化证据。

summary: Discourse parsing based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) is crucial for capturing the structural dynamics of dialogues. However, most prior research focuses on English, and its effectiveness for Japanese remains unclear owing to the lack of Japanese SDRT corpora. To address this issue, we construct Japanese SDRT corpora by translating existing English SDRT corpora using an LLM. Through a comparative evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs, we show that the models achieve comparable performance between English and Japanese, suggesting the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing. In order to investigate why the English and Japanese parsers achieve similar performance, we conduct ablation analyses on discourse markers and contextual inputs. Our results reveal that most of the Japanese discourse markers we examined have little impact, and the models' predictions depend heavily on contextual discourse relations rather than on the content of the context clauses. This structural reliance might explain the comparable performance despite the substantial typological differences between English and Japanese.
title: Japanese Discourse Structure Analysis Based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory Using LLMs
