title_translated: EmbeddingGemma 2：统一高效的多模态表示
summary_translated: 我们提出EmbeddingGemma 2，一个开源的多模态嵌入模型，能够原生地将文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合统一表示在一个空间中。我们的方法引入了诸如简化每层嵌入、多阶段课程学习（包含模态与目标逐步推进）等改进，确保在单模态、跨模态和混合模态评估中均表现出色。特别地，在涵盖所有模态的全面嵌入基准测试中，EmbeddingGemma 2确立了新的帕累托前沿，超越了专用模型以及规模大两到十二倍的模型。此外，我们的设计在资源受限环境下也具备灵活性，支持选择性加载模态编码器、可调节视觉标记预算、可截断的嵌入维度以及量化权重。我们展示了关键决策的消融分析，并发布EmbeddingGemma 2以促进后续研究。

summary: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.
title: Modeling Preference Dependencies with Directed Acyclic Graphs for Narrative-Driven Recommendation
title_translated: 基于有向无环图建模偏好依赖关系以实现叙事驱动推荐
summary_translated: 叙事驱动推荐允许用户通过自由文本表达多维度需求，其中陈述的偏好自然地相互限定和条件化。现有方法通常将叙事视为扁平化的关键词组合或不受约束的生成查询，未能捕捉复杂偏好如何层级细化并相互上下文化。我们提出偏好依赖图框架（PDG-F），一种以显式偏好依赖为核心的叙事驱动推荐框架。具体而言，PDG-A（PDG-代理）首先解析非结构化请求，将用户偏好及其相互限定组织成有向无环偏好依赖图（PDG）。通过该图，利用有向路径检索从开放网络获取候选证据，最终通过拓扑路径排序确定推荐结果。在涵盖英语和中文语境的三个多样化领域中的综合实验表明，PDG-F在推荐性能上持续优于竞争性基线、开放域检索代理和前沿语言模型。进一步的诊断分析显示，我们的依赖引导检索显著提升了可达到的候选池上限，证明了在叙事驱动推荐中建模偏好依赖的根本价值。

summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves higher mean performance than full evaluation in most settings while using approximately half as many evaluation cells.
title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
title_translated: 在LLM驱动的智能体架构演化中，评估预算应如何分配？
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体架构演化通过迭代生成候选方案并进行评估来优化智能体工作流。评估既指导后续搜索，也决定最终的架构选择，但对每个候选方案在完整任务集上进行全面评估会带来巨大的执行成本。本文研究了如何在两个角色之间分配评估预算。实验表明，稀疏反馈即可维持有效的演化过程，而有针对性的额外评估能显著提升最终选择质量。回放分析进一步揭示，共享的有信息量内容和共同的评分参考有助于对表现相近的候选方案进行比较。受此启发，我们提出了\method，一种结合稀疏运行时反馈与目标化最终确认的评估分配框架。通过简短的全评估预热阶段建立共享的信息核心，并校准响应模型，其项目参数在搜索过程中保持固定。搜索完成后，\method重新拟合模型并应用成对连续减半策略，复用累积观测结果，仅执行缺失的评估。在四个基准测试和两种演化框架下，\method在多数设置中实现了比完全评估更高的平均性能，同时评估单元数量约为后者的一半。

summary: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.
title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
title_translated: 水印盆地：黑盒检测蒸馏后的LLM
summary_translated: 专有语言模型及其推理轨迹容易受到基于API的蒸馏攻击，即攻击者利用教师模型输出训练学生模型。为获取蒸馏证据，模型提供方可对教师输出进行水印处理，旨在使学生输出中留下‘放射性’信号。现有黑盒检测器通过分析可疑模型输出的词元级统计特征来寻找此类信号。然而，当蒸馏轨迹以低温度采样时，词元级信号可能无法被检测到。本文发现了一种持久存在的信号——水印盆地：在微调过程中，带有水印的教师轨迹在参数空间中嵌入了一个独特且与特定密钥相关的几何信号，该信号垂直于常规的任务特定微调子空间。基于此，我们提出Watermark Basin Alignment（WM-Basin），一种无需访问模型权重或logits的黑盒水印检测方法。WM-Basin通过API查询可疑模型，使用固定的干净探测模型将生成文本映射为梯度表示，剔除常规微调任务方向后，检验残差梯度是否与水印密钥诱导的水印盆地对齐。我们在多种教师模型和学生架构（从135M到8.2B参数）上进行了广泛评估，这些模型均在数学推理任务上被蒸馏。在严格的0.1%假阳性率下，WM-Basin在n-gram=1时检测到79%的蒸馏模型，在n-gram=3时检测到45%，显著优于当前最优的词元级基线（分别为29%和1.3%）。由于水印信号存在于一个持久的盆地中，它能够抵御蒸馏后的修改，包括量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练。

summary: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.
title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
title_translated: 你的策略其实是隐藏的约束：智能体接口的决策几何
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体通过一种‘约束’（harness）进行后训练和部署，该约束由提示、工具和控制逻辑组成，用于向模型呈现任务并执行其输出。约束通常根据已训练模型的表现进行修订和评估，这假设模型在某一约束下所学知识可迁移到下一约束。我们探讨了策略从其约束中学到了什么，以及当约束改变时哪些内容得以保留。在KL正则化控制下，我们证明最优策略的对数几率反映了其约束对各动作的偏好强度，因此训练后的策略携带了其约束的偏好。部署后的回报等于约束所能提供的最大回报（天花板）减去策略自身的不匹配损失（因次优决策导致的回报损失）。训练仅改变不匹配项，而改变约束则同时影响两项。因此，使用固定模型比较不同约束时，混合了约束本身的能力与模型利用该能力的效率。在MiniWoB++中，后训练使模型偏好与其训练约束高度绑定。反转观察字段顺序后，所有最优决策不变，但训练后模型的成功率从85.0%降至19.2%。相反，任何固定模型比较中被拒绝但能提升天花板的新约束，在进一步训练后均优于原智能体，且事前测量的天花板与不匹配项可预测这些提升。在Terminal-Bench Lite的编码智能体约束上，使用更强模型作为最优近似估算的天花板减不匹配项，重现了准确率排序，而单独任一指标则无法做到。代码已公开于https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.
title: Uncovering Shortcut Amplification in Video RLVR through the Lens of Perceptual Uncertainty Collapse
title_translated: 通过感知不确定性坍塌视角揭示视频RLVR中的捷径放大现象
summary_translated: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型多模态模型（LMMs）视频推理能力的有效后训练范式。尽管其在实践中表现出色，但我们发现，基于结果的优化可能引入不良的捷径放大效应，即模型越来越倾向于依赖文本先验的答案，即使这些答案缺乏视觉证据支持。为刻画这一行为，我们从感知不确定性的角度分析视频RLVR的训练动态，研究在视频条件与纯文本情境下预测不确定性的演变过程。我们的分析揭示了一种‘感知不确定性坍塌’现象：RL训练持续锐化模型的回答分布，而视觉证据带来的不确定性降低却逐步减弱。进一步的梯度方向分析表明，这种置信度提升越来越偏离视觉基础的不确定性减少，反而主要由文本先验压缩主导。受此启发，我们提出双焦点自蒸馏策略优化（BSPO），一种通过两种互补的分布信号调节策略更新的自蒸馏框架。具体而言，BSPO从组内正确与错误的滚动回放中提取经验推理原则，识别对推理敏感的词元，并引入对捷径敏感的视觉扰动，惩罚在任务相关视觉证据削弱时仍保持不变的预测。通过自适应重加权原始RL优势，BSPO在保留RLVR任务求解优势的同时，促进更具推理敏感性和视觉根基的更新。大量实验验证了BSPO在提升视频推理性能和增强视觉忠实度方面的有效性。

summary: Coverage-evaluation benchmarks quantify whether retrieved evidence covers the different pieces of information needed to satisfy an information need. Existing benchmarks mostly consider factual claims that may already be known to pretrained retrieval components, leaving open whether retrievers find corpus evidence when it contradicts those priors. We study how retrievers behave when their parametric knowledge and the information in a corpus disagree. To do so, we develop a process to augment a nugget-based coverage benchmark with controlled contradictions. For each nugget, we create a negated counterpart and edit its supporting documents to support that negation while preserving the context. Applying this process to CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage, we create CoverageBench-Negate, spanning six datasets and roughly 63,000 original-edited evidence pairs (one per nugget-document link). We attach rich construction metadata to every pair and additionally provide out-of-family LLM judgments over all pairs and a human audit of a sample. In baseline experiments, BM25 separates original from edited near-twin evidence substantially better than dense retrievers (Qwen3 and Jina), which stay near chance. We release the benchmark on Hugging Face Datasets (nuggets, documents, pairs) together with the construction materials, including the prompts used to create it.
title: Coverage Under Contradiction: A Benchmark for Negation-Aware Retrieval
title_translated: 矛盾下的覆盖率：一种关注否定的检索基准
summary_translated: 覆盖率评估基准用于衡量检索到的证据是否覆盖满足信息需求所需的各个信息片段。现有基准大多关注那些可能已被预训练检索组件知晓的事实主张，未明确回答当检索器的参数化知识与语料库信息相矛盾时，检索器的行为如何。我们研究了当模型的先验知识与语料库信息冲突时，检索器的表现。为此，我们开发了一种流程，将基于事实片段的覆盖率基准扩展为包含可控矛盾的数据。针对每个事实片段，我们创建其否定版本，并编辑其支持文档以支持该否定，同时保持上下文一致。我们将此方法应用于CoverageBench（衡量信息覆盖率的基准），构建出CoverageBench-Negate，涵盖六个数据集，约63,000个原始-编辑证据对（每对对应一个事实-文档链接）。我们为每对添加丰富的构造元数据，并额外提供跨家族LLM判断及部分人工审计。基线实验显示，BM25在区分原始与编辑近似证据方面显著优于密集检索器（Qwen3和Jina），后者表现接近随机水平。我们已在Hugging Face Datasets上发布该基准（含事实、文档、配对）及构建材料，包括生成所用提示。

summary: Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture. These results show that output metrics and structural checks can both miss mechanistic damage, motivating circuit-level causal analysis as a complementary evaluation of compressed language models.
title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
title_translated: Transformer语言模型中权重剪枝的机制性失效模式
summary_translated: 剪枝后的语言模型几乎完全通过准确率和困惑度来评估，这假设保留的输出行为意味着内部计算也被保留。我们通过对GPT-2进行因子剪枝实验，交叉测试了两种重要性标准（幅度、随机）、两种组件类型（注意力头、MLP神经元）以及三种稀疏度水平（3%、50%、70%）。以完全表征的间接宾语识别（IOI）电路为基准，使用激活修补、路径修补和直接logit归因来测量电路完整性。我们发现了两种定性上截然不同的失效模式：幅度头剪枝≥零会导致电路失效：面向输出的头被移除，模型性能降至接近随机水平；而幅度神经元在30%剪枝时则出现反转：全部26个电路头仍完整，但Name Mover贡献项符号翻转，模型系统性地偏好错误名称（准确率为17.7%）。然而，困惑度将其排名为比随机头剪枝损伤更小（74.6 vs 140.1）。对Greater-Than电路的复现表明，关键组件类型取决于电路架构。这些结果表明，输出指标和结构检查都可能遗漏机制性损伤，从而推动了以电路级因果分析作为压缩语言模型互补评估方法的需求。

summary: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. On a knowledge graph built from the semiconductor-manufacturing literature, Prospector approaches the strongest off-the-shelf models given the same graph and tools, and it far exceeds off-the-shelf models answering closed-book or from a pre-selected portion of the graph. Although trained only on the semiconductor graph, Prospector transfers to unseen knowledge graphs from three other distinct fields: bio-inspired materials, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and materials properties. Served on a single GPU, Prospector answers faster and at a fraction of the cost of a hosted service, while keeping proprietary data on the owner's hardware. We find that the policy's latent state is indicative of its next move on both seen and unseen graphs, and modulating the latent state can steer the policy from one behavior mode to another. These results suggest a practical LLM + KG paradigm for scientific and engineering reasoning over private data, in which a compact model trained on a graph from published literature transfers its traversal to unseen graphs that stay with their owners.
title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
title_translated: Prospector：学习一种紧凑的图遍历策略用于科学推理
summary_translated: 在特定工程领域中，科学推理依赖于分散在文献中的知识，这些知识往往具有专有性且未包含在前沿大模型的训练数据中。在此类领域中，前沿模型通常给出泛化性答案。知识图谱（KG）可以为大模型推理提供基础。由于图谱过于庞大无法完整提供，典型的LLM+KG系统会在推理开始前预先选择一部分内容，判断相关性。本文提出训练一种紧凑模型Prospector，通过逐步遍历领域知识图谱进行推理，根据已发现的信息寻找证据。Prospector一次调用一组小型工具，逐步构建其上下文，并以可逐边验证的证据链形式作答，这些证据来自其工具从图谱中检索的内容。在一个基于半导体制造文献构建的知识图谱上，Prospector在相同图谱和工具条件下接近最强的现成模型表现，远超仅能回答闭卷问题或基于预选部分图谱的现成模型。尽管仅在半导体图谱上训练，Prospector可迁移至其他三个不同领域的未见知识图谱：仿生材料、全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）以及材料属性。部署在单个GPU上，Prospector的响应速度更快，成本仅为托管服务的几分之一，同时将专有数据保留在所有者硬件上。我们发现，该策略的隐状态在已见和未见图谱上均能指示其下一步动作，调节隐状态可实现行为模式之间的切换。这些结果表明，一种实用的LLM+KG范式可用于私有数据上的科学与工程推理，即一个在公开文献图谱上训练的紧凑模型，能够将其遍历能力迁移至由所有者持有的未见图谱。

summary: We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstrate substantial improvements in training efficiency, generation quality, and few-step generation. In particular, SERF achieves up to 7.7x wall-clock training acceleration on OpenWebText, improves MAUVE by 24.3% and GSM8K accuracy by up to 28.8%, and matches baseline performance with up to 64x fewer sampling steps. These results establish noisy-to-clean self-distillation as an effective approach to improving continuous diffusion language models.
title: Self-Regularized Flow Language Models
title_translated: 自正则化流语言模型
summary_translated: 我们提出了SERF（自正则化流语言模型），一种简单的自监督框架，通过利用去噪轨迹本身来改进连续扩散语言模型。虽然连续流基语言模型为自回归生成提供了有前景的替代方案，但其训练目标通常依赖于干净目标词的监督，导致去噪轨迹作为学习信号被低估。SERF通过噪声到清洁的自蒸馏解决这一局限：指数移动平均（EMA）教师接收学生在同一条插值路径上的更清洁输入版本，并提供额外监督。我们研究了两种变体：SERF-L，将学生的中间表示与更深教师的表示对齐；SERF-P，对齐它们的输出词分布，可在学生输出层或早期学生层进行。所有变体在不需外部预训练模型或修改推理过程的前提下，增强了标准训练目标。在三种连续语言模型范式（one-hot FLM、latent ELF 和 hyper-spherical S-FLM）上的实验表明，训练效率、生成质量和少步生成均有显著提升。特别是，SERF在OpenWebText上实现了高达7.7倍的墙钟时间训练加速，MAUVE提升24.3%，GSM8K准确率最高提升28.8%，并可在最多减少64倍采样步骤的情况下匹配基线性能。这些结果确立了噪声到清洁的自蒸馏是改进连续扩散语言模型的有效方法。

summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.
title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
title_translated: EnergyCal：驯服Muon家族优化器在稀疏MoE训练中的损失尖峰
summary_translated: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）语言模型训练在使用Muon家族优化器时可能出现巨大的损失尖峰。我们引入了EnergyCal，一种轻量级规则，通过规范化平方Frobenius范数的有限步Newton-Schulz方向来抑制路由专家的更新。EnergyCal保持谱变换不变，并不增加持久的优化器状态。我们在一个40亿参数的MoE模型上评估了该方法。与经过开发选择、学习率较低的MuonH配方相比，EnergyCal-MuonH将平均阈值损失尖峰负担降低了99.51%，最终几何平均困惑度降低4.06%，仅带来适度的吞吐量代价。在与普通Muon在匹配名义学习率和权重衰减的情况下，平均损失尖峰负担减少达95.98%（在两个测试指数下），并伴随微小的终点改进。这些发现支持在所评估设置中无论是否使用Hyperball，该方法均具有稳定性增强效果。

summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) typically relies on preference pairs generated from diverse model pools and ranked by an external LLM judge. The recently proposed delta-learning hypothesis suggests that comparable supervision can instead be obtained from a single pair of models by treating the larger model's response as preferred. We investigate the limits of this approach across model families and scales. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that fixed model pairs introduce systematic, generator-dependent biases that are predictive of the preference label independent of response quality. Consequently, DPO trained on single-pair data consistently underperforms multi-model preference data, despite the larger generator producing higher-quality responses, and we trace this gap to training dynamics consistent with reward hacking on these biases. We further show that simply increasing the number of generators, even without an external judge, is enough to partially mitigate this effect. Our results highlight generator diversity as a critical factor in preference-data construction.
title: Exploring the Limits of the Delta Learning Hypothesis: Single-Pair Generator Biases in Direct Preference Optimization
title_translated: 探索Delta学习假说的极限：直接偏好优化中的单对生成器偏差
summary_translated: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通常依赖于从多样化模型池中生成的偏好对，并由外部LLM裁判进行排序。最近提出的delta学习假说认为，仅通过一对模型即可获得相当的监督信号，即将较大模型的响应视为优选。我们跨模型族和规模探究了该方法的极限。我们从理论和实证两方面证明，固定模型对会引入系统性、生成器相关的偏差，这些偏差独立于响应质量即可预测偏好标签。因此，即使较大生成器产生更高质量的响应，基于单对数据训练的DPO始终表现逊于多模型偏好数据，我们将其差距归因于与奖励劫持一致的训练动态。此外，我们进一步证明，仅增加生成器数量，即使没有外部裁判，也足以部分缓解这一效应。我们的结果强调了生成器多样性在偏好数据构建中的关键作用。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong empirical gains in improving the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) on tasks such as mathematics and programming. However, recent studies have shown that RLVR rollouts often collapse onto a narrow set of reasoning trajectories, limiting the explored reasoning space. Motivated by findings that thinking tokens at critical steps serve as critical structural elements in LLM reasoning pathways, we propose Guided-RLVR, a novel approach that augments RLVR with a lightweight controller. The controller strategically injects semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution, encouraging the model to approach problems from multiple reasoning perspectives and thereby expanding the exploration space. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Guided-RLVR consistently outperforms existing RLVR methods while producing more diverse reasoning trajectories.
title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
title_translated: Guided-RLVR：基于可验证奖励的强化学习中的引导探索
summary_translated: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLMs）在数学和编程等任务上的推理能力方面表现出显著的实证优势。然而，近期研究发现，RLVR的推理轨迹往往收敛到狭窄的路径上，限制了推理空间的探索。受关键步骤中思考标记作为LLM推理路径中关键结构元素的启发，我们提出了Guided-RLVR，一种通过轻量级控制器增强RLVR的新方法。该控制器战略性地将语义有意义的引导标记注入采样分布，鼓励模型从多种推理视角接近问题，从而扩展探索空间。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，Guided-RLVR持续优于现有RLVR方法，同时产生更丰富的推理轨迹。

summary: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect, an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.
title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
title_translated: 无需缩放的缩放v2：从观察细节到连接证据以实现可泛化的多模态感知
summary_translated: 多模态感知构成了多模态智能的基础。特别是空间感知和多模态长上下文理解是支撑具身AI和多模态代理的两个关键任务。然而，为这些任务合成目标明确、高质量的训练数据仍然困难且成本高昂。我们的核心洞察是，这些任务共享一种潜在能力，称为“连接证据”：识别相关视觉事实，将其绑定到正确实体，恢复其关系，并组合成答案。至关重要的是，针对这种能力合成目标训练数据远比直接为这些任务本身合成要容易得多。为强化这一能力，我们提出EvidenceConnect，一个易于实现的数据合成框架，利用单张图像中相关区域的放大视图生成需要比较、聚合或链式推理视觉证据的问题。为确保质量，仅当独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）达成一致时才保留参考答案，并通过区域消融测试剔除在移除选定区域后答案仍保持不变的问题。随后，我们使用RLVR在生成的数据上训练基础VLM，得到“无需缩放的缩放v2”（ZwZ2）。尽管合成数据并非针对任何下游基准定制，ZwZ2在细粒度和空间感知方面均取得改进，并在具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解、多模态代理任务和通用视觉推理上获得进一步提升。这些结果确立了EvidenceConnect作为监督证据连接的有效框架，并表明强化这一共享能力可带来更具泛化性的多模态感知。

summary: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.
title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
title_translated: V-LUMEN：用于视觉-语言模型嵌入扩展的视觉查找记忆
summary_translated: 嵌入级扩展通过基于查找的记忆而非增加模型深度、宽度或密集计算来扩展语言模型的能力。将这一思想扩展到视觉-语言模型（VLMs）具有挑战性，因为视觉特征是连续的、具有空间结构且依赖查询，与自然支持n-gram查找的离散文本标记不同。我们引入V-LUMEN，一种面向VLMs的视觉查找记忆。V-LUMEN通过冻结的码本对视觉特征进行离散化，通过基于空间聚合的哈希构建空间感知的记忆键，并用文本条件相关的相关性信号进行调制；所有访问均为非参数化，检索到的嵌入通过门控残差路径融合到主干网络中。在五个高推理强度的基准测试中，V-LUMEN显著提升了冻结的Qwen3-VL-2B主干模型，并在图像与训练数据不重叠的三个基准上实现了零样本迁移。在匹配的参数预算下，将LoRA或MoE适配器的部分容量转移到V-LUMEN，可在两个主干模型上保持准确率，表明外部视觉记忆是一个独立的能力轴，而非更强的适配方法。由于查找成本仅随表大小恒定且仅在预填充阶段发生一次，该能力的增长体现在存储而非每标记计算上。代码已公开于 https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.
title: SpectRAG: Weighted Chunk Graphs for Token-Budgeted Context Selection in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation

title_translated: SpectRAG：用于多跳检索增强生成中令牌预算上下文选择的加权块图
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过检索外部证据并基于检索到的上下文来约束大语言模型（LLMs）的生成，从而实现 grounded 推理。尽管密集检索在局部语义匹配方面有效，但独立排名的检索可能返回冗余段落，遗漏跨块依赖关系，并为多跳推理提供不完整的证据。我们提出SpectRAG，一种谱图增强的检索框架，结合混合候选种子生成、加权块图构建、基于图的扩展、谱相关性传播以及令牌预算下的上下文选择。文档块由密集语义嵌入和来自加权块图的图谱坐标表示，其中边编码语义相似性、文档相邻性、章节层级、共享实体、引用链接以及LLM生成的效用问题之间的相似性。在查询时，SpectRAG使用精确内积搜索和混合相关性信号构建高召回率种子集，通过块图进行扩展，利用图邻近性和谱信息重新评分候选，并在固定令牌预算下组装最终上下文。目标不仅是检索单个相似块，而是构建一个相关、多样、结构连通且足以支持 grounded 推理的上下文。在MultiHopRAG、UltraDomain和长文档问答设置上的实验表明，SpectRAG在广泛证据回收方面表现优异，并在生成质量上与密集、混合、HyDE、LightRAG和NaiveRAG基线竞争。结果进一步表明，图谱结构在面向推理和跨文档检索中尤为有用，同时揭示了早期精度、计算成本和领域依赖性能之间的权衡。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.
title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
title_translated: AutoVend：在长期自主售货运营中对LLM智能体的基准测试
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正将网络上的代理中介商业从消费者购物扩展至为卖家运营企业。在在线到线下（O2O）商业中，决策通过基于网络的平台发出，但需通过昂贵的物理执行来实现。评估此类智能体需要超越单个交易，考察线上决策是否能转化为持续的经济回报。我们引入AutoVend，一个基准测试，其中单一LLM智能体通过基于网络的操作界面，在180个模拟天内管理20台分布在五种站点类型的自动售货机。其数据驱动的模拟器结合了共享仓库、采购前置时间、付费补货、库存过期和持续运营成本。我们评估了五个LLM智能体，并与基于规则的库存控制基线进行对比，诊断其在站点协调、执行和随时间推移的表现。在评估的五个LLM智能体中，有四个未能达到该基线水平，且每美元推理成本的回报排名与仅看总回报排名不同。运营分析显示，个别指标的提升并不总是带来更强的经济增长，因为库存和执行成本会侵蚀这些收益。轨迹分析进一步揭示了在实现可行动作、管理库存承诺以及将反馈转化为有效策略修订方面的困难。

summary: Handwritten text recognition (HTR) for the registers of Pope Honorius III depends on modern expert transcriptions, which exist only for regnal years 1-2 of Reg. Vat. 9. For the remaining registers, nineteenth-century scholarship offers Pressutti's regesta and partial editions. On fol. 1-203, where both layers exist, we measure what this legacy layer can contribute, on transcriptions that we first audit against it, and find a division of labor across three tiers. At the orthographic tier, raw editions are at best neutral for adapting a recognizer to the second regnal year and harmful without replay, whereas projection onto curial spelling with replay of modern source lines turns them into zero-label adaptation targets: pooled over all 134 year-2 sides, the WER falls by 1.50 points (95% CI -1.84 to -1.15), closing 33% of the gap to an oracle; the spelling changes at the year split, through the scribe or the transcriber, whereas the hand changes visibly only at fol. 191r. At the lexical tier, the corpus-wide legacy lexicon contains 82.2% of the out-of-vocabulary words of unedited entries and flags recognition errors with 66.7% precision, and labels from pre-trained medieval NER models, distilled into the recognizer's NER head, reach F1 82.1% on an expert validated benchmark, level with the best tagger applied after recognition. At the topological tier, Pressutti's regests, the closing datum clauses, and the regests' dates converted to the chancery's Roman form find 73.9% of entry starts in the recognized line stream, and edition agreement estimates a CER of 7.80% beyond fol. 203. Antiquarian scholarship thus cannot replace modern transcription, but it can steer, check, and segment HTR across the untranscribed registers.
title: Mining the Nineteenth Century for the Thirteenth: Register-Scale Forced Alignment and HTR Bootstrapping via Legacy Regesta and Antiquarian Editions
title_translated: 从十九世纪文献中挖掘第十三世纪文本：基于历史编年与古籍版本的注册文本强制对齐与HTR自举方法
summary_translated: 针对教皇霍诺里乌斯三世登记册的手写文本识别（HTR）依赖于现代专家转录，但仅限于第V册第1-2个统治年份。对于其余部分，十九世纪学术成果提供了普雷苏蒂的编年史和部分版本。在第1-203页，两种资料层并存的情况下，我们评估了这一历史资料层对转录的贡献，发现其在三个层级上具有分工作用。在拼写层级，原始版本在未重播的情况下对适应第二年份的识别器基本无益甚至有害；而通过重播现代源文本投影到教廷拼写后，可转化为零标签适应目标：在全部134个第二年份页面上，词错误率（WER）下降1.50点（95%置信区间 -1.84 至 -1.15），缩小了与理想模型之间差距的33%；拼写变化出现在年份分界处，由抄写员或转录者引起，而手写体变化仅在第191r页明显可见。在词汇层级，整个语料库的历史词汇包含未编辑条目中82.2%的未登录词，并以66.7%的精度标记识别错误；预训练中世纪命名实体识别（NER）模型的标签经提炼注入识别器的NER头，在专家验证基准上达到F1 82.1%，与最佳后识别标注器水平相当。在拓扑层级，普雷苏蒂的编年记录、结尾数据子句以及转换为枢机院罗马形式的日期，可在识别出的行流中找到73.9%的条目起始位置，且在第203页之后的版本一致性估计显示字符错误率（CER）为7.80%。因此，古籍学术研究虽不能替代现代转录，但可引导、校验并分割未转录登记册的HTR过程。

summary: We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.
title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: HiLo-RD：面向掩码扩散语言模型的跨预算自蒸馏方法
summary_translated: 我们提出HiLo-RD（高预算到低预算表示蒸馏）以在有限生成预算下提升掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）的性能。与自回归模型不同，MDLMs同时决定生成内容和提交位置，这带来两个耦合挑战：在推理完成前预测有用内容，以及决定何时固定影响后续预测的答案标记。我们识别出预算导致的过早承诺问题：即使正确解法能容纳，模型也可能在窗口边界附近提前固定答案片段，这些片段成为后续预测的上下文并引导推理方向。现有后训练方法无法直接传递同一模型在更大窗口下所遵循的更强推理轨迹。HiLo-RD通过（1）将大窗口教师状态与裁剪后的短窗口视图配对，（2）在已承诺位置匹配其隐藏表示，从而解决该问题。这种监督机制无需外部教师即可指导标记预测与承诺顺序。在数学基准测试中，HiLo-RD提升了低预算下的准确率并缩短响应长度；这些优势在代码生成任务中亦有效，无需代码领域训练。在GSM8K上，准确率提升9.4个百分点，平均可读长度减少约25%。注意力诊断与固定预算顺序干预支持所提出的机制。结果表明，大窗口推理可改善小窗口解码。

summary: Deep research agents conduct multi-step Web searches and synthesise retrieved information into analytical reports. Evaluating these outputs requires checking which analyses they deliver, beyond the presence of relevant facts. Query-specific binary rubrics make individual requirements explicit, but task-level checklists may leave the overall analytical structure underexamined. We introduce RubricAtlas, which derives type-level analytical requirements from expert reports on different objects within the same research type and organises detailed checks around recurring analytical questions. The requirements give related tasks a shared standard for what to analyse, without prescribing their answers. Our framework links binary checkpoints to report passages and evaluates completeness separately from argument validity. Built from 3,079 Chinese financial research reports, RubricAtlas covers 99 research types. Reference-report selection experiments show that individual reports cover only about half of their type's analytical questions, and that selecting requirements from different reports changes evaluation scores and agent rankings. Across ten agents, two judge pipelines achieve checkpoint agreement of $κ$ = 0.71 and agent-ranking agreement of Kendall $τ$ = 0.87. Controlled deletions reduce scores on the affected analyses, while padding produces no detectable increase. These findings support type-level rubrics for comparing the analytical completeness of Web deep research outputs, with individual decisions traceable to report evidence.
title: RubricAtlas: Mining Type-Level Rubrics from Expert Reports to Evaluate Deep Research Agents
title_translated: RubricAtlas：从专家报告中挖掘类型级评分标准以评估深度研究智能体
summary_translated: 深度研究智能体执行多步网络搜索并将检索信息整合为分析报告。评估其输出需检查其是否提供分析性内容，而不仅仅是相关事实。查询特定的二元评分标准可明确个体要求，但任务级清单可能使整体分析结构被忽视。我们提出RubricAtlas，从同一研究类型的多个对象的专家报告中提取类型级分析要求，并围绕反复出现的分析问题组织详细检查。这些要求为相关任务提供统一的分析标准，而不规定具体答案。我们的框架将二元检查点与报告段落关联，并分别评估完整性与论证有效性。基于3,079份中文金融研究报告构建，RubricAtlas覆盖99种研究类型。参考报告选择实验表明，单个报告仅涵盖其类型分析问题的一半左右，且从不同报告中选取要求会改变评估分数与智能体排名。在十种智能体上，两种评审流程达到$κ$ = 0.71的检查点一致性，以及Kendall $τ$ = 0.87的智能体排名一致性。受控删除降低受影响分析的得分，而填充操作未产生可检测的提升。这些发现支持使用类型级评分标准来比较网络深度研究输出的分析完整性，且个体决策可追溯至报告证据。

summary: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA
title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
title_translated: GUI-JEPA：候选动作条件化的JEPA潜在表示作为移动GUI智能体的快速动作策略
summary_translated: 移动GUI智能体通常微调7B规模的视觉-语言模型（VLM），逐token生成每个动作。然而，这些VLM逐token解码动作，即使采用候选动作评分机制，仍需保持大型语言模型或VLM在循环中运行，导致速度慢且内存占用高。为解决这些问题，我们提出GUI-JEPA，据我们所知是首个基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）构建的无解码器GUI智能体策略，它在预先在未标注GUI截图上训练的JEPA编码器的潜在空间中选择动作。其动作与区域条件化的潜在预测器将屏幕潜在表示转换为每个候选动作对应的单一潜在向量，使轻量级头部能在单次批处理中对所有候选动作进行评分，无需逐token解码。我们进一步证明评分器依赖此潜在路径，且预测器是为决策本身训练的：随机初始化的预测器表现与在屏幕动态上预训练的预测器相当。在AndroidControl上，GUI-JEPA在相同GPU上比我们用相同输入微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B智能体快2.8-4.0倍，同时以6%的参数量达到其86-92%的分布内准确率。代码见https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

summary: GUI grounding on high-resolution screens fails mostly on small targets, and zooming in is a common training-free remedy. However, most existing zooming pipelines do not match the zoom to the target's size, accept the zoomed answer unconditionally and never revisit a wrong answer. To address these issues, we propose AdaGround, a training-free framework with three components: (1) Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming, which sets the magnification, field of view and zoom depth of each sample from the model's own estimate of the target size; (2) Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement, which uses one marked-click Yes/No verifier to keep or reject each zoom, choose between zoom chains, trigger re-grounding and, with an existence query, decide when to abstain; and (3) Compositional Structure Grounding, which composes spreadsheet cells from their headers. On Qwen3-VL models, AdaGround surpasses state-of-the-art training-free zooming methods and many trained GUI models, improving accuracy over the backbone by 7.4 to 20.6 points on OSWorld-G and ScreenSpot-Pro, and its gains carry over to held-out UI-Vision. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround
title: AdaGround: Token-Normalized Adaptive Zooming with Verifier-in-the-Loop Refinement for GUI Grounding
title_translated: AdaGround：带验证器回路优化的令牌归一化自适应缩放用于GUI定位
summary_translated: 在高分辨率屏幕上，GUI定位失败主要由于目标过小，而缩放是常见的免训练修复方法。然而，大多数现有缩放流程未根据目标大小调整缩放程度，无条件接受缩放结果，且从不重新审视错误答案。为解决这些问题，我们提出AdaGround，一种免训练框架，包含三个组件：（1）令牌归一化自适应缩放，根据模型自身对目标大小的估计，动态设定每样本的放大倍数、视野范围和缩放深度；（2）验证器回路优化，使用一个标记点击的“是/否”验证器来决定保留或拒绝每次缩放，选择缩放链，触发重新定位，并通过存在性查询决定何时放弃；（3）组合结构定位，从其标题组合电子表格单元格。在Qwen3-VL模型上，AdaGround超越最先进的免训练缩放方法及许多训练过的GUI模型，在OSWorld-G和ScreenSpot-Pro上相比基线模型准确率提升7.4至20.6个百分点，其增益也延续至未见的UI-Vision数据集。代码见https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/AdaGround

summary: Multimodal large language models have made substantial progress in visual question answering, but complex visual reasoning often requires locating and comparing multiple pieces of question-relevant visual evidence. Existing methods that move intermediate reasoning into the visual latent space usually follow a single linear reasoning trajectory, which can be limiting when multiple visual hypotheses or competing evidence regions are relevant. We propose Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning, a branch-aware latent reasoning framework that generates multiple question-conditioned latent visual branches as soft hypotheses over image tokens. To train these branches, our method uses bounding-box evidence annotations to build target evidence representations and introduces a soft contrastive branch-evidence alignment objective. This objective encourages evidence-relevant branches to align with annotated visual regions while contrasting them against negative evidence. We instantiate our method on Qwen2.5-VL backbones and train it with standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on perception-intensive visual reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves overall improvements over the corresponding backbone and single-path latent reasoning baselines at both 3B and 7B scales.
title: Latent Visual Contrastive Reasoning with Multi-Branch Exploration
title_translated: 基于多分支探索的潜在视觉对比推理
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型在视觉问答任务中取得了显著进展，但复杂的视觉推理通常需要定位并比较多个与问题相关的视觉证据。现有方法将中间推理过程引入视觉潜在空间时，通常遵循单一线性推理路径，当存在多个视觉假设或竞争性证据区域时，这种做法可能受到限制。我们提出了潜在视觉对比推理，这是一种具有分支感知能力的潜在推理框架，通过生成多个与问题相关的潜在视觉分支作为图像标记的软假设。为了训练这些分支，我们的方法利用边界框证据标注构建目标证据表示，并引入一种软对比分支-证据对齐目标。该目标鼓励与证据相关的分支与标注的视觉区域对齐，同时将其与负向证据进行对比。我们在Qwen2.5-VL骨干网络上实现了该方法，并采用标准的监督微调进行训练。在感知密集型视觉推理基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的方法在3B和7B规模下均优于对应的骨干模型和单路径潜在推理基线，整体性能有所提升。

summary: Commercial language model APIs return only text, allowing a provider to cut costs by quietly routing a fraction of user requests to a cheaper substitute model while billing for the advertised one. Detecting such partial substitution is challenging because honest providers also alter the output distribution through undocumented decoding and serving choices, such as temperature scaling, sampling truncation, repetition and presence penalties, and default system prompts, forcing an audit to test against a composite null of legitimate configurations rather than a single reference. Our key insight is that these legitimate variations primarily shift response typicality across the entire batch, whereas partial substitution injects individual responses that remain anomalous under the claimed model. Building on this, we introduce API-TAIL, a typicality audit that first absorbs batch-level shifts by aligning a single effective temperature to center standardized surprisal scores across the audited batch, and then flags the endpoint if the number of remaining tail responses exceeds a threshold calibrated across legitimate configurations. Evaluated on real-world commercial APIs, API-TAIL reliably controls false alarms across diverse honest providers while detecting even low-rate partial substitution with a small query budget, substantially outperforming existing rank- and MMD-based audits that lose detection power under the same composite calibration.
title: API-TAIL: Detecting Model Substitution in LLM APIs through Temperature-Aligned Likelihood Tails
title_translated: API-TAIL：通过温度对齐似然尾部检测LLM API中的模型替换
summary_translated: 商业语言模型API仅返回文本，使得服务提供商可以通过悄悄地将部分用户请求路由到更便宜的替代模型来降低成本，同时仍按宣传的模型计费。检测此类部分替换具有挑战性，因为诚实的服务商也会通过未公开的解码和部署选择（如温度缩放、采样截断、重复和存在惩罚、默认系统提示）改变输出分布，迫使审计必须针对一个由合法配置组成的复合零假设，而非单一参考。我们的关键洞察是，这些合法变化主要在整个批次上平移响应的典型性，而部分替换则会注入在声称模型下仍保持异常的个别响应。基于此，我们提出了API-TAIL，一种典型性审计方法：首先通过调整单一有效温度来吸收批次级别的偏移，使标准化意外度分数在审计批次中居中；然后，如果剩余尾部响应数量超过在合法配置中校准的阈值，则标记该端点。在真实世界商业API上的评估表明，API-TAIL在多种诚实提供商中可靠地控制了误报率，同时以少量查询预算即可检测到极低频率的部分替换，显著优于现有的基于排名和MMD的审计方法，在相同复合校准下检测能力更强。

summary: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.
title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
title_translated: Select-TTT：面向就地测试时训练的查询条件选择性快速权重更新
summary_translated: 测试时训练（TTT）使已部署的语言模型能够将输入上下文实时内化为一组小规模的快速权重参数，而不是仅仅将其视为注意力机制中的临时上下文。就地TTT最近通过重新利用标准MLP块的降维投影作为快速权重，使这一想法在大型语言模型中变得可行。然而，我们发现其优势在真实的网页长上下文问答任务中几乎消失。我们将其归因于就地TTT的均匀写入策略：每个块都以同等强度写入，导致无关内容稀释了快速权重记忆中的查询相关信息。基于这一洞察，我们提出了Select-TTT，一种无需模型依赖、基于查询条件的规则，用于就地TTT，根据每个块与用户查询的相关性来调节其写入强度。该相关性信号无需监督且不引入新参数：它直接从模型冻结输出头读取，即块隐藏状态分配给查询标记的概率质量。经过温度缩放的softmax将这些得分转换为学习率乘数，同时保持就地TTT原有的逐块并行计算结构。Select-TTT在两个基准测试和两个骨干模型上一致提升了长上下文问答表现。这些发现突显了在长上下文问答任务中，基于查询条件的快速权重写入对于实际测试时训练的价值，也对涉及多轮用户查询和动态上下文的长期智能体任务具有潜在前景。

summary: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to 72.1% on LiveBench-Math (with $2\times2$) and from 49.0% to 60.0% on HoVer (with $8\times1$). A simple runtime model explains the measured speedups under a finite worker pool, and batched settings also spend their metric-call and dollar budgets more efficiently. We frame the axes along which a reflective optimization step can scale in parallel, a first look at allocating a fixed optimization budget across them.
title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better

title_translated: 批处理反思优化循环：并行提案使GEPA更快更优
summary_translated: 反思式文本优化可提升智能体系统的性能，但其优化循环本身是一个资源消耗巨大的工作负载，其顺序结构导致并行评估能力闲置。我们将开源的GEPA优化器扩展为在每一步优化中同时提出并评估一批候选方案，而非一次只处理一个候选。在两项任务的全面测试中，大多数批处理运行的墙钟时间减少了一半或更多，最快甚至缩短至四分之一到三分之一。批处理设置还获得了更高的保留测试得分：在LiveBench-Math上从68.9%提升至72.1%（使用$2	imes2$），在HoVer上从49.0%提升至60.0%（使用$8	imes1$）。一个简单的运行时模型解释了在有限工作者池下的测量加速效果，批处理设置也更高效地使用了指标调用和资金预算。我们首次系统性地探讨了反思优化步骤在并行方向上的可扩展性维度，为如何在固定优化预算下分配这些维度提供了初步视角。

summary: Mamba-2 compresses all context into a fixed-size recurrent state that dominates decoding memory and bandwidth. Existing compressors quantize state values or prune state coordinates, scoring each channel independently in the native basis. We examine trained Mamba-2 states and find that energy is almost rank-one, but the output does not read the energetic directions: energy concentrates in a bias-like direction accumulated by the recurrence, while the content the output reads lives in a low-dimensional subspace that is not aligned with the state's coordinates. Even output-aware scores are computed coordinate by coordinate, so they miss the directions that determine the input--output map. Compression should therefore target the write--read subspace rather than individual coordinates. We propose \method{}, a post-training transform that instantiates balanced truncation with full controllability and observability Gramians and applies the rotation exactly via Mamba-2's scalar-identity transition. Because the useful rank varies widely across layers, we further introduce HARP, which allocates ranks per layer from the Hankel spectrum and protects retrieval-sensitive layers, improving both perplexity and retrieval over uniform budgets. Calibration takes a single forward pass, an order of magnitude faster than GHOST's released protocol, with lower peak memory. With HARP, \method{} halves the state dimension at an average WikiText-2 perplexity increase of $0.3$ points ($1.8\%$) across 130M--2.7B, versus $1.6$ ($9.3\%$) for GHOST, and the gap widens at 25\% retention.
title: Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression
title_translated: Mamba-2状态压缩的平衡状态子空间
summary_translated: Mamba-2将所有上下文压缩为固定大小的递归状态，该状态主导了解码过程中的内存和带宽。现有压缩方法对状态值进行量化或剪枝状态坐标，独立地在原始基底下评估每个通道。我们分析了训练后的Mamba-2状态，发现能量几乎呈秩一分布，但输出并未读取能量方向：能量集中在由递归累积产生的类似偏置的方向上，而输出所读取的内容则存在于一个与状态坐标不对齐的低维子空间中。即使输出感知的评分也是逐坐标计算的，因此忽略了决定输入-输出映射的关键方向。因此，压缩应聚焦于写入-读取子空间，而非单个坐标。我们提出了	extmethod{}，一种后训练变换，通过全可控性和可观测性Gramian实现平衡截断，并通过Mamba-2的标量-恒等过渡精确应用旋转。由于各层有用秩差异较大，我们进一步引入HARP，根据Hankel谱为每层分配秩，并保护检索敏感层，从而在统一预算下同时提升困惑度和检索性能。校准仅需一次前向传播，比GHOST发布的协议快一个数量级，且峰值内存更低。使用HARP，	extmethod{}在130M–2.7B范围内将状态维度减半，平均WikiText-2困惑度仅增加0.3点（1.8%），而GHOST则增加1.6点（9.3%），在25%保留率时差距进一步扩大。

summary: The trustworthiness of Web content faces a growing threat from multimodal fake news. Real news usually shows aligned image-text semantics, while fake news often contains a few conflicts at varying levels, such as mismatches in objects, scenes, events, and claims. However, existing methods usually treat consistency and conflict in a coarse and static way, limiting their ability to capture sparse conflicts and adapt to varying conflict levels. Inspired by the distinct knowledge encoded across layers in large language models, we propose Multi-Level Consistency and Conflict Decoupling (MLCCD), which captures conflicts at different levels from different layers of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Specifically, we first use the MLLM's final decision representation to select visual and textual tokens relevant to the task, preventing irrelevant content from diluting sparse conflicts. Then, we preserve tokens whose representations change sharply between adjacent layers, capturing the knowledge each layer adds. Finally, we decouple this knowledge into consistency and conflict evidence and aggregate each across layers with its own router, adapting to varying conflict levels. Experiments on three benchmarks show that MLCCD outperforms existing methods.
title: Decoupling Consistency and Conflict across MLLM Layers for Fake News Detection
title_translated: 解耦多层MLLM中的一致性与冲突以检测虚假新闻
summary_translated: 网络内容的可信度正面临多模态虚假新闻日益严重的威胁。真实新闻通常表现出图像与文本语义的一致性，而虚假新闻则在不同层次上存在若干冲突，例如物体、场景、事件和主张之间的不匹配。然而，现有方法通常以粗粒度且静态的方式处理一致性和冲突，限制了其捕捉稀疏冲突并适应不同冲突水平的能力。受大型语言模型各层编码不同知识的启发，我们提出了多层级一致性与冲突解耦（MLCCD）方法，能够从多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的不同层中捕捉不同层次的冲突。具体而言，我们首先利用MLLM的最终决策表示来选择与任务相关的视觉和文本标记，防止无关内容稀释稀疏冲突；然后保留相邻层间表示发生剧烈变化的标记，以捕捉每层所增加的知识；最后，将这些知识解耦为一致性和冲突证据，并通过各自路由机制在层间聚合，从而适应不同冲突水平。在三个基准上的实验表明，MLCCD优于现有方法。

summary: Chunking is a fundamental preprocessing step in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), yet most existing chunkers rely primarily on heuristics. We introduce the Question--Evidence-Supervised Chunker (QESChunker), to our knowledge the first method for constructing static chunk indices from question--evidence supervision. QESChunker constructs document-specific chunk indices by optimizing over human-annotated or LLM-generated question--evidence pairs, without access to held-out test queries. We formulate non-overlapping and overlapping index construction through a unified question--evidence utility-maximization objective, turning chunking into a supervised combinatorial optimization problem. Under the non-overlap constraint, the objective decomposes over chunks and can be optimized exactly in polynomial time by dynamic programming. When overlap is allowed, the objective becomes monotone submodular; exact optimization is NP-hard, but our greedy achieves a $(1-1/\sqrt{e})$-approximation. Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants outperform existing chunking methods in complete-evidence recall in nearly all evaluated settings, under the same overlap regime and a fixed hybrid retriever. These results recast chunking as supervised, budget-aware index construction for evidence retrieval.
title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
title_translated: QESChunker：单一目标统一重叠与非重叠分块用于RAG
summary_translated: 分块是检索增强生成（RAG）中的基础预处理步骤，但大多数现有分块器主要依赖启发式方法。我们引入了问题-证据监督分块器（QESChunker），据我们所知，这是首个从问题-证据监督中构建静态分块索引的方法。QESChunker通过优化人工标注或LLM生成的问题-证据对来构建特定文档的分块索引，无需访问保留的测试查询。我们通过统一的问题-证据效用最大化目标来形式化非重叠与重叠索引的构建，将分块转化为有监督的组合优化问题。在无重叠约束下，目标在分块上可分解，可通过动态规划精确地在多项式时间内优化；当允许重叠时，目标变为单调子模，精确优化为NP难，但我们的贪心算法可达到$(1-1/\\/sqrt{e})$近似比。在两个自建和三个公开数据集上，两种变体在几乎所有评估设置中均优于现有分块方法，在相同重叠率和固定混合检索器条件下实现了更高的完整证据召回率。这些结果将分块重新定义为有监督、预算感知的证据检索索引构建。

summary: Final-answer accuracy reports whether a vision-language model was right, but not whether its answer was grounded in the image, whether its stated reasoning reflects that evidence, or what the answer cost to produce. Those are the properties that decide whether a system can be deployed. We present PRISM-BENCH, a benchmark of 1,000 expert-curated questions spanning five under-represented reasoning categories, in which every item carries an idealized reasoning trace written by one human annotator and validated by another. The traces support two diagnostics that accuracy cannot provide. A perception probe, in which the model answers from a description it wrote itself, attributes roughly 85% of frontier-model failures to misperception and places the bottleneck at grounding. Trace alignment predicts answer correctness for all 25 systems tested (macro AUROC 0.66) and survives length control, so it measures reasoning content and not verbosity. We further introduce CORE, an efficiency-aware metric that reorders 24.2% of model pairs relative to accuracy while remaining uncorrelated with response length. Across 25 open and closed systems, including GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4.6, the best accuracy is 66.0%. On the four categories with a human baseline the best system trails humans by 18.4 points, and recent frontier gains fall on recognition and not on spatial grounding.
title: PRISM-BENCH: Diagnosing Grounded and Faithful Multimodal Reasoning Beyond Final-Answer Accuracy

title_translated: PRISM-BENCH：超越最终答案准确率的具身与忠实多模态推理诊断
summary_translated: 最终答案准确率仅报告视觉-语言模型是否正确，却无法反映其答案是否基于图像、其陈述的推理是否反映相应证据，或生成答案的成本。这些属性决定了系统能否实际部署。我们提出PRISM-BENCH，一个包含1000个专家精心设计问题的基准，涵盖五个代表性不足的推理类别，每个条目均由一名人类标注者撰写理想化推理轨迹，并由另一名标注者验证。这些轨迹支持两种准确率无法提供的诊断：感知探测（模型根据自身撰写的描述作答），发现约85%前沿模型失败源于误感知，瓶颈在于具身性；轨迹对齐能预测所有25个系统测试的答案正确性（宏AUROC 0.66），且不受长度控制影响，因此衡量的是推理内容而非冗长程度。我们进一步引入CORE，一种效率感知指标，在24.2%的模型对中重新排序，同时与响应长度无关。在25个开放与封闭系统中（包括GPT-5和Claude Opus 4.6），最高准确率为66.0%。在四个具有人类基线的类别中，最佳系统仍落后于人类18.4分，近期前沿进展集中在识别而非空间具身。

summary: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/
title: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
title_translated: RoboAuto：通过多层次物理理解实现自主机器人程序搜索
summary_translated: 最近，基于大语言模型的自主智能体在迭代生成、评估和优化可执行解决方案方面展现出强大能力。在机器人操作中，代码即策略（Code-as-Policy）使这些智能体能够在模块化且可编辑的机器人程序中进行搜索。然而，有效的程序搜索需要物理理解：智能体必须理解物体如何被操作、场景几何如何约束动作，以及为何某些交互成功或失败。现有方法主要依赖执行反馈进行程序优化，常导致这些物理问题未被解决。我们提出RoboAuto框架，通过三个组件显式组织对象、场景和交互层面的物理理解。第一，分层知识库结合可执行技能与以对象为中心的可操作性、空间关系和动作效应知识，从具身数据和在线任务求解中学习；第二，场景具身将该知识连接到当前环境，通过识别相关对象并解析动作关键量；第三，多阶段规划结合自设计实验，检验每一阶段是否产生预期的物理效果，并主动测试竞争假设以解决物理不确定性。RoboAuto在五个基准家族中表现优异，在短周期LIBERO-PRO任务中达到89.1%的成功率，在LIBERO-PRO Long和LIBERO-Plus上成功率超过ASPIRE的两倍。它还在三个需要精确操作的长周期真实机器人任务中优于ASPIRE和$π_{0.5}$。我们还展示了知识库可在模拟器和实体之间迁移，且程序搜索性能随知识库规模增长。项目页面：https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

summary: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.
title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
title_translated: 将注意力偏差折叠进键值可使压缩KV缓存运行在标准内核上
summary_translated: 注意力匹配（AM）通过每头保留部分键值，重新拟合其值并为每个保留键添加偏置，从而压缩KV缓存。FlashAttention和vLLM的分页缓存无法直接使用该方法。我们沿每头一个闭式方向将偏置折叠进键中，该方向在上下文查询上拟合，得到一个普通缓存，具有AM的大小和头维度，以及模型自身的查询路径；输出误差由每个查询在该方向上的投影距离1的程度决定。在每头预算相等的情况下，未经修改的vLLM可通过KV连接器服务折叠后的缓存，在全部51个Qwen3-4B问题上与Hugging Face的结果匹配，并在200个Qwen3-14B LongBench样本中的180个上匹配贪婪输出。在QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B）和LongHealth（三个Qwen3模型）上，同等预算下，折叠方法在14个设置中的13个中与AM精度处于噪声范围内，且在12个两者均运行的设置中，其KL值低于丢弃偏置的情况。在已发布的每头预算下，对于Qwen3-4B、其Instruct-2507变体和Llama-3.1-8B，其在10个中的9个中与AM处于噪声范围内，不再优于丢弃偏置的KL，且两者在准确率上各胜一次。

summary: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains largely unexplored. We introduce MedConstBench, a medical-ethics benchmark that treats the deployment constitution as a controlled variable, is organized around Beauchamp's four principles, and is scored by human-calibrated multi-model peer review. It includes MedDilemma, our own dataset of clinical dilemmas, and supports a systematic analysis of how constitutions steer LLMs. Evaluating ten open-source LLMs under four constitutions, we find that the effect of a constitution is dimension-selective and model-dependent, and that no constitution is universally optimal. Motivated by these findings, we propose a do-no-harm adaptive selector that chooses a constitution per model, matching the per-model oracle while guaranteeing a worst-case floor and generalizing to unseen models at low cost.
title: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
title_translated: MedConstBench：评估宪法如何引导大语言模型在医学伦理中的表现
summary_translated: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，它们被越来越多地用于回答医学问题，许多模型已部署于本地。模型部署后，其行为主要由写入其“宪法”中的伦理政策决定。然而，现有研究大多关注事实正确性，而非不同伦理价值之间的权衡。即使有评估伦理的基准，也通常将伦理视为模型的固定属性而非可变变量，因此宪法如何重塑医学伦理行为仍基本未被探索。我们提出了MedConstBench，一个以部署宪法为可控变量、围绕贝奥查姆的四大原则组织、并通过人类校准的多模型同行评审评分的医学伦理基准。该基准包含我们自建的临床困境数据集MedDilemma，并支持系统分析宪法如何引导LLMs。在四种宪法下评估十种开源LLM，我们发现宪法的影响具有维度选择性和模型依赖性，且不存在普遍最优的宪法。基于这些发现，我们提出一种“不伤害”自适应选择器，根据模型动态选择宪法，在匹配每模型最优策略的同时保证最坏情况下的底线性能，并以低成本泛化到未见过的模型。

summary: Cross-modal translation requires models to capture shared semantics across modalities while preserving the fine-grained structure required by the target modality. Yet in real-world scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect, while obtaining clean pairs at scale is costly. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) directly optimizes cross-modal translation through categorical token-level supervision, but this objective is sensitive to errors in the target sequences. JEPA offers a complementary representation-space objective, but most existing formulations focus on prediction within a modality rather than translation across modalities. We introduce Anchored Cross-Modal JEPA (AC-JEPA), an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions using paired data. The joint-embedding objective targets cross-modal structure predictable from context, while the causal SFT path retains direct token-level supervision for the target sequence. During self-training, AC-JEPA learns from continuous latent targets derived from imperfect pseudo-labeled pairs, offering intrinsic tolerance to local data errors without promoting pseudo-tokens to hard categorical supervision. Using optical chemical structure recognition as a testbed, AC-JEPA trained on clean pairs achieves 76.07% accuracy on the Simple set of the WildMol benchmark, compared with 67.40% for SFT alone. Using the same pseudo-labeled data for both approaches, AC-JEPA-based self-training further raises accuracy to 80.23%, whereas accuracy under direct SFT drops from 67.40% to 63.47%. These results support SFT-anchored joint-embedding prediction as an effective strategy for cross-modal translation under both curated and imperfect supervision.
title: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
title_translated: AC-JEPA：用于视觉到符号翻译的锚定跨模态联合嵌入预测架构
summary_translated: 跨模态翻译要求模型捕捉不同模态间的共享语义，同时保留目标模态所需的细粒度结构。然而在真实科学领域中，成对数据往往不完美，而大规模获取干净配对数据成本高昂。监督微调（SFT）通过类别标记级别的监督直接优化跨模态翻译，但该目标对目标序列中的错误敏感。JEPA提供了互补的表示空间目标，但大多数现有方法聚焦于模态内部的预测而非跨模态翻译。我们提出锚定跨模态JEPA（AC-JEPA），一种与SFT兼容的插件式方法，利用成对数据在两个跨模态方向上预测被掩码的中间状态。联合嵌入目标针对从上下文中可预测的跨模态结构，而因果SFT路径则保留对目标序列的直接标记级监督。在自训练过程中，AC-JEPA从由不完美伪标签对生成的连续潜在目标中学习，对局部数据错误具有内在容错性，且不会将伪标记提升为硬类别监督。以光学化学结构识别为测试场景，AC-JEPA在干净数据上训练达到WildMol基准Simple集76.07%的准确率，优于仅使用SFT的67.40%。在相同伪标签数据下，基于AC-JEPA的自训练进一步将准确率提升至80.23%，而直接SFT的准确率则从67.40%下降至63.47%。这些结果支持SFT锚定的联合嵌入预测是应对精心标注和不完美监督下跨模态翻译的有效策略。

summary: Do vision-language models (VLMs) share our ability to communicate visually? We share preliminary findings, starting from a surprising observation: simple visual symbols like a red heart can strongly influence model behavior on seemingly unrelated tasks, such as steering models towards recursive solutions on simple coding problems. Notably, this steering effect is largely implicit, as models' direct interpretations and thinking traces about visual symbols diverge substantially from their observed behavior. In visual communication between models, this leads to a generation--interpretation gap: while models tend to send shape primitives that they (and humans) find intuitive, these visual cues often fail to steer other models. In further communication games involving abstract concepts and stories, models can creatively use visuals to transmit meaning to one another, although some communications remain non-intuitive to humans. These findings reveal that VLMs might be capable of rich, creative, and visually-grounded communication, but their interpretation and production of visual meaning diverges from human conventions in surprising ways. Together this work highlights both the promise and challenges of visual communication between humans and VLMs.
title: A Heart Means Recursion: Exploring Visual Meaning and Communication in VLMs
title_translated: 一颗心意味着递归：探索视觉意义与VLM中的交流
summary_translated: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）是否具备与我们类似的视觉交流能力？我们分享初步发现，起源于一个令人惊讶的观察：像红色心形这样的简单视觉符号，能显著影响模型在看似无关的任务上的行为，例如在简单的编码问题中引导模型走向递归解法。值得注意的是，这种引导效应在很大程度上是隐性的，因为模型对视觉符号的直接解释和思维轨迹与其观察到的行为存在显著差异。在模型之间的视觉交流中，这导致了生成-解释差距：尽管模型倾向于发送它们（及人类）认为直观的形状基元，但这些视觉线索往往无法有效引导其他模型。在涉及抽象概念和故事的进一步交流游戏中，模型能够创造性地使用视觉元素相互传递意义，尽管部分交流对人类而言仍不直观。这些发现揭示，VLMs可能具备丰富、创造性和基于视觉的交流能力，但其对视觉意义的解读与生成方式与人类惯例存在出人意料的偏离。整体而言，这项工作凸显了人类与VLMs之间视觉交流的潜力与挑战。

summary: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma
title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding

title_translated: SOMA：细粒度第一人称行为与身体运动理解的基准测试
summary_translated: 感知人体运动对于理解并协助人类的多模态系统至关重要。然而，当前对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的评估主要集中在物体、场景和粗略动作上，对其自身对身体的理解能力评估不足。尤其从第一人称视角来看，身体仅部分可见，运动必须从被遮挡和时间分布的线索中推断。我们提出了SOMA，一个面向第一人称视频中细粒度身体运动理解的基准，包含1,632个经人工验证的问题，涵盖三个能力维度：身体构型、运动动力学和时间推理。我们评估了37个领先的闭源、开源及专用第一人称MLLMs，并辅以广泛的真人评估。结果显示，仅凭视频人类也难以完成此任务（准确率为68.5%），但仍明显优于最强的MLLM（Qwen3.6-27B），后者零样本准确率为50.0%。我们的错误分析表明，MLLMs常误读佩戴者自身身体，时间事件判断不准，且存在诸如偏好右手或重复计数不足等偏差。为缩小与人类表现的差距并推动进一步进展，我们引入了一个对齐视频、身体运动和语言监督的训练数据集，以及一个联合学习这些模态的多模态基线。通过识别当前MLLMs的常见失败模式和缺失能力，我们希望SOMA能激发未来关于身体运动理解和多模态推理的研究。完整基准、训练数据和代码将发布于：https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma

summary: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.
title: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation

title_translated: 跨模态引导向量在图像与文本生成中均存在
summary_translated: 当前AI模型中，概念与机制在不同模态间是否统一，还是各自独立实现？我们通过研究跨模态引导来操作化这一广泛问题：1）找到能在某一模态的标记上成功引导生成的向量；2）然后零样本转移到另一模态的标记上添加时，是否仍能引导生成。我们的研究超越了简单的相关对齐（如表示相似性），因为引导本质上是因果性的。我们在几种统一多模态模型（UMMs）中研究跨模态引导，因其在语言和图像生成中共享参数，重点关注这两个模态。在多种被引导的概念（如情绪、物体大小）中，我们展示了引导向量在两个方向上均能实现零样本迁移（文本→图像与图像→文本）。即使对于高度特定于某一模态的概念（如正式与非正式语言），引导向量在另一模态中仍常引发一致且可解释的效果，如正式服装与设计。这种迁移还具有几何特征：尽管文本与图像表示之间存在明显的模态鸿沟，但具有强跨模态可迁移性的引导向量在相同概念上往往指向相似方向。我们的发现揭示了统一多模态模型内部视觉与语言的交互机制，并指向更通用、模态无关的控制方法。

summary: The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like "love of owls") into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with "You love owls" from those prompted with "You love eagles", and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. In both cases prompted classifiers, including the generating model itself, remain near chance. The signal partially persists across model families, with the Qwen base model reading signals generated by Olmo and vice versa. This is evidence for a non-trivial prediction of the PSM, and the method may be practically useful for auditing the hidden objectives of models.
title: Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss

title_translated: 基础模型可检测提示词遗漏的隐藏意图
summary_translated: 人格选择模型（PSM）认为，后训练阶段会选择在预训练期间学到的人格。关于隐性学习的研究表明，模型可以将隐蔽信号（如“喜欢猫头鹰”）嵌入到语义无关的输出中，例如数字串，而接受这些输出训练的学生会继承这些特征。本文展示，通过在基础预训练模型上使用适当的头部评估此类输出的可能性，我提出的方法称为人格-头部似然评估（PHLE），能够解码这些隐性信号并进行分类。例如，PHLE 可以区分由后训练模型在提示“你喜爱猫头鹰”下生成的数字序列与在提示“你喜爱鹰”下生成的序列，也能区分具有隐藏伤害用户欲望的模型（经过过滤以消除明显偏差）与无系统提示的模型生成的答案。在这两种情况下，提示词分类器（包括生成模型本身）的表现仍接近随机水平。该信号在不同模型家族间部分保留，例如 Qwen 基础模型能读取 Olmo 生成的信号，反之亦然。这为 PSM 提出了非平凡的预测证据，该方法可能在审计模型隐藏目标方面具有实际应用价值。

summary: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.
title: Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs
