title_translated: 学会阅读盲文：视觉语言模型盲文识别能力的基准测试与改进
summary_translated: 尽管在视觉理解与文档转录方面取得了快速进展，现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在一项基本无障碍任务——从图像中读取盲文方面仍表现不佳。我们引入了 BrailleBench，一个手动整理的包含259张真实世界一级和二级盲文图像的基准数据集。我们评估了专有模型、开源权重模型、OCR专用模型以及工具辅助的多模态系统，发现独立的通用模型在直接转录盲文图像方面表现较差，而工具辅助系统则显著更优。我们设计了一个合成盲文生成流程，涵盖多样化的布局和图像扰动。在一个基于合成数据训练的20亿参数VLM模型上，其在一级盲文上的精确匹配率达到87%，二级盲文达到61%，优于独立VLM，并在所有评估系统中取得最高的二级盲文精确匹配分数。我们进一步发现，合成验证数据上的高准确率并不能保证在真实照片上的高性能：在先前合成数据上训练的模型在合成验证集上最高可达96%准确率，但在一级盲文基准测试上最高仅3.26%。我们的结果揭示了多模态系统在无障碍相关能力上的差距，并表明有针对性的合成监督可以提升真实世界中的盲文转录性能。

summary: A retrieval-augmented language model answers from two sources, the retrieved context and its own knowledge, and the two disagree whenever the context is incomplete or wrong. Existing methods settle the disagreement with a rule fixed at design time: follow the context, amplify it in proportion to how far it moves the model, or trust the model's memory. Each rule is confidently wrong in some deployment. In a decision-theoretic model of two sources, the score of any fixed rule is linear in the share of reliable contexts while the best attainable score is convex, so every fixed rule is beaten wherever it is not exactly optimal; and a symmetric divergence between the two sources, the signal adaptive decoding uses, carries no information about which one is right. Resolving a conflict therefore needs two inputs that no existing method keeps: evidence about each source separately, and a prior on how often the context is right. We test these claims on GRACE, a benchmark that intervenes on the knowledge-graph context of a fixed question, so that what the model knows, what the context says and what is true are measured separately. There, every baseline from four families is strong on right contexts or on wrong ones, never on both. We then build the two inputs: the model states its knowledge as notes, a small policy voices each note with a calibrated confidence, a reader answers in two voices, and a selector commits or abstains under a prior $π$ applied as an exact prior shift. With $π$ set to the true share of right contexts, the system is above the best baseline at every mixture of GRACE contexts, by up to 26 points. Its overall score is 45.3 and 35.0 (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B), against 29.4 and 27.5 for the best baseline. On preregistered ClashEval it beats same-backbone CK-PLUG and TCR by 12 and 26 points. Where the model lacks the knowledge, the gains vanish, as the theory predicts.
title: Don't Pick a Winner: Knowledge Conflicts Need a Prior, Not a Rule

title_translated: 不要急于选赢家：知识冲突需要先验，而非规则
summary_translated: 检索增强型语言模型从两个来源获取答案：检索到的上下文和自身的知识，当上下文不完整或错误时，两者会产生分歧。现有方法通过设计时固定的规则解决分歧：遵循上下文、按上下文偏离程度放大其影响，或信任模型的记忆。然而，每种规则在某些部署场景中都会出现严重错误。在双源决策理论模型中，任何固定规则的得分随可靠上下文占比呈线性变化，而最佳可实现得分是凸函数，因此每个固定规则在非最优处均被超越；且两源之间的对称性差异无法提供哪个来源正确的信息。因此，解决冲突需要两个现有方法未保留的输入：分别针对每个来源的证据，以及上下文正确的先验概率。我们在GRACE基准上验证了这些观点，该基准干预固定问题的知识图谱上下文，使模型所知、上下文所述与真实情况得以分别测量。在此基准上，来自四个类别的所有基线在正确上下文或错误上下文上表现强劲，但从不在两者上同时表现良好。随后我们构建了这两个输入：模型以笔记形式表达自身知识，一个小策略为每条笔记赋予校准后的置信度，阅读器以双重声音作答，选择器在先验π作用下做出承诺或放弃。当π设置为真实正确上下文比例时，系统在GRACE所有上下文混合中均优于最佳基线，最高提升达26分。其总体得分分别为45.3和35.0（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B），而最佳基线分别为29.4和27.5。在预先注册的ClashEval上，其比同主干的CK-PLUG和TCR分别高出12和26分。当模型缺乏知识时，收益消失，正如理论预测。

summary: Accurate prediction of human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) is crucial for evaluating synthetic speech quality in text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC). Most MOS predictors output only point estimates and ignore uncertainty, limiting reliability in model selection and deployment. We propose ConformalMOS, a framework that augments MOS prediction with conformal prediction to produce statistically valid prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability, alongside point estimates. During training, MOS labels are modeled in an ordinal-aware manner by converting one-hot targets into Gaussian-smoothed distributions, preserving score ordering. This improves uncertainty calibration, particularly when softmax confidence is overconfident on out-of-distribution speech. On BVCC datasets, ConformalMOS achieves competitive accuracy (MSE = 0.08) while delivering empirically validated coverage, enhancing reliability for real-world TTS and VC deployment.
title: ConformalMOS: Uncertainty-Aware MOS Prediction with Conformal Intervals and Ordinal Modeling
title_translated: ConformalMOS：基于共形区间与序数建模的不确定性感知MOS预测
summary_translated: 准确预测人类平均意见评分（MOS）对于评估文本转语音（TTS）和语音转换（VC）中合成语音质量至关重要。大多数MOS预测器仅输出点估计值，忽略不确定性，限制了在模型选择和部署中的可靠性。我们提出ConformalMOS框架，通过引入共形预测，在保持交换性条件下生成具有保证覆盖率的统计有效预测区间，同时提供点估计。训练过程中，MOS标签以序数感知方式建模，将独热目标转化为高斯平滑分布，保留评分顺序。这提升了不确定性校准效果，尤其在softmax置信度对分布外语音过度自信时表现更佳。在BVCC数据集上，ConformalMOS实现了竞争性精度（MSE = 0.08），同时提供了经验验证的覆盖率，增强了真实世界TTS和VC部署的可靠性。

summary: Test-time updating lets a language model change persistent state after training---such as model weights, adapter parameters, or a memory module---before or while answering queries. Existing evaluations often compare systems using update count or frequency and performance measured immediately afterward. These summaries omit what is updated, where, when, and in what order. The same total can therefore hide an important difference: one system may answer after one update while another answers after two. We introduce the Control Map, an evaluation framework that records the committed updates preceding each scored answer and separately evaluates behavioral changes, immediate learning (acquisition), later recall (retention), preservation of unrelated behavior (locality), and performance in new settings. We prove when counts alone determine final state and show, under stated assumptions, how differences between pre-answer histories limit differences in average scores. Using ControlMap, our experiments reveal three insights. First, update scheduling matters: at a 760M-parameter checkpoint, 24 schedules with the same update count yield 19.7%--34.2% accuracy. Second, learning an edit does not guarantee that it lasts or remains contained: all six selected CounterFact LoRA settings learn the new information, while ROME retains edits at all 13 operating points but fails locality at each. Third, no editor performs best consistently across models, benchmarks, and tests. Evaluations should therefore report update histories and assess acquisition, retention, and locality separately.
title: Beyond Update Counts: A Control Map for Evaluating Test-Time Model Updates
title_translated: 超越更新次数：用于评估测试时模型更新的控制图
summary_translated: 测试时更新允许语言模型在训练后改变持久状态——如模型权重、适配器参数或记忆模块——在回答查询前或过程中进行修改。现有评估通常仅比较系统更新次数或频率与后续性能，但忽略了更新内容、位置、时机及顺序。因此，相同的总更新次数可能掩盖重要差异：一个系统可能在一次更新后回答，另一个则在两次更新后回答。我们引入控制图（Control Map）这一评估框架，记录每次评分答案之前发生的已提交更新，并分别评估行为变化、即时学习（获取）、后期回忆（保留）、无关行为的保持（局部性）以及新环境下的表现。我们证明了仅凭更新次数决定最终状态的条件，并在给定假设下说明预回答历史差异如何限制平均得分差异。通过ControlMap实验，我们得出三个关键发现：第一，更新调度至关重要：在760M参数检查点上，24种相同更新次数的调度方案导致准确率在19.7%至34.2%之间波动；第二，学习一次编辑并不意味着它能持续或保持局部性：六个选定的CounterFact LoRA设置均学会了新信息，而ROME在全部13个操作点上保留了编辑，但在每个点上均失败于局部性；第三，没有编辑器在所有模型、基准和测试中始终表现最佳。因此，评估应报告更新历史，并分别评估获取、保留和局部性。

summary: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student's trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD's entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens. With Fin-SD, general reasoning on MMLU-Pro and a fourteen-metric compliance audit on FinTrust show no material regression.
title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning

title_translated: 提示的重要性有多大？金融推理中事后自蒸馏的范围条件
summary_translated: 在数据本地化约束下运营的金融机构只能使用足够小以本地部署的开放权重模型，这类模型在多步定量推理任务上落后于前沿系统。在线策略蒸馏通过监督学生模型自身生成的轨迹来缩小这一差距，但传统在线策略蒸馏（OPD）需要一个强大的外部教师模型，而在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）则依赖完整的参考解决方案作为条件。我们探讨了该信号中究竟有多少是必要的。本文提出Fin-SD，一种用于多步推理的本地化事后自蒸馏方法。当学生模型在解决某个问题时失败，它会自行识别出第一个错误的推理步骤，并对该步骤撰写简短批评。我们在错误发生前截断学生轨迹（旨在获得正确的前缀），将冻结的学生副本条件于同一前缀加上提示，并在反KL散度下对提示条件化的教师模型进行短期回放蒸馏。整个过程无需外部模型提供梯度。我们将Fin-SD应用于GPT-OSS-20B，在一个自定义的多步金融推理基准上测试，该基准要求通过会计惯例从现实场景中推导公式输入。实验发现：(i) 用通用反馈替代批评，仍能实现与Fin-SD相同的3.03个百分点准确率提升，表明收益主要来自监督的位置而非提示内容；(ii) 提示的生成模型无需强于接收提示的模型：同系列的GPT-OSS-120B（参数量约为6倍）生成的提示并未带来显著更优的效果；(iii) Fin-SD在准确率上达到与完整参考解的在线策略自蒸馏相当水平，同时生成的token减少9.5%。使用Fin-SD后，MMLU-Pro上的通用推理能力以及FinTrust的十四项合规审计均未出现明显性能下降。

summary: We present SCOPE, a multi-agent system for profiling news media outlets with respect to bias, factuality, and credibility. Given an outlet URL, SCOPE coordinates specialized agents for article acquisition, content analysis, external evidence search, scoring, and report generation. The system follows an MBFC-style methodology while making intermediate evidence and agent outputs inspectable through a structured demonstration interface. On a benchmark of 200 media outlets, SCOPE outperforms LLM-only, article-only, search-only, and media-background-check baselines on most metrics, achieving the lowest bias and factuality MAE, perfect failed-fact-check detection, and the lowest factual error rate. These results suggest that decomposed, evidence-grounded agent workflows can support more transparent and reliable media profiling. Our code is available at https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE, and a live demonstration at https://scope-demo.streamlit.app/.
title: SCOPE: Source Credibility and Outlet Profiling Engine
title_translated: SCOPE：新闻媒体可信度与来源画像引擎
summary_translated: 我们提出SCOPE，一个用于评估新闻媒体在偏见、事实性和可信度方面的多智能体系统。给定一个媒体网站URL，SCOPE协调多个专用智能体完成文章获取、内容分析、外部证据搜索、评分和报告生成等任务。该系统采用MBFC风格的方法论，同时通过结构化演示界面使中间证据和智能体输出可被检查。在包含200个媒体来源的基准测试中，SCOPE在多数指标上优于仅使用大语言模型、仅分析文章、仅执行搜索或仅依赖媒体背景核查的基线方法，实现了最低的偏见和事实性平均绝对误差（MAE），完美检测到失败的事实核查，且事实错误率最低。这些结果表明，分解式、基于证据的智能体工作流能够支持更透明、更可靠的媒体画像。代码已公开于https://github.com/mbaisbay/SCOPE，实时演示可在https://scope-demo.streamlit.app/访问。

summary: Emergent generative AI technologies, while remarkably beneficial across several tasks and domains, can suffer from unforeseen vulnerabilities and difficult-to-anticipate failure modes. Such failure modes can disparately affect vulnerable communities. This paper investigates two well-known vision language models (VLMs) and inspects how these models encode protected identities while generating images. We show that when VLMs are requested to transform human face images to reflect race identities (e.g., Hispanic, Black, White, or Asian) and sexual orientation (e.g., gay or straight), VLMs often comply with such requests. We demonstrate that compliance (and refusal) is non-deterministic, group-sensitive, and generated images are statistically distinguishable, often accentuating deep-seated stereotypes. We further show that representation biases introduced during image generation can re-emerge in textual reasoning and characterization tasks. Finally, we show that this worrisome finding is not limited to racial identity or sexual orientation, image generation can perpetuate bias around criminality, raising concerning possibilities of AI-assisted profiling.
title: Physiognomy Revisited: How Vision-Language Models Encode Sensitive Attributes Through Image Transformation
title_translated: 相貌学再探：视觉-语言模型如何通过图像变换编码敏感属性
summary_translated: 新兴的生成式AI技术虽然在多个任务和领域表现出显著优势，但也可能面临难以预见的漏洞和异常失效模式，这些模式可能对弱势群体造成不成比例的影响。本文研究了两种知名的视觉-语言模型（VLMs），并探究其在生成图像过程中如何编码受保护的身份信息。我们发现，当请求VLM将人脸图像转换为反映种族身份（如拉丁裔、黑人、白人或亚裔）或性取向（如同性恋或异性恋）时，这些模型通常会响应此类请求。我们证明，这种响应（及拒绝）具有非确定性、群体敏感性特征，生成的图像在统计上可区分，且常常强化根深蒂固的刻板印象。此外，我们还发现图像生成过程中引入的表示偏差会在后续的文本推理和人物描述任务中重新显现。最后，我们指出这一令人担忧的现象不仅限于种族或性取向，图像生成还可能延续关于犯罪性的偏见，引发AI辅助身份画像的严重风险。
